name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.BezoutFrame.exists_frame

    ∃ a d b c : R, a*b = x ∧ d*c = y ∧ d*b = z ∧ a*c-d*b = 1

lemma coordinate_equation (t : Frame R) (z : R) :

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Cylinder.Frame.e_certificate
statement:
lemma e_certificate (t : Frame R) (l w : R) :
    t.p ^ 3 * t.e l w - (l - t.root) =
    (t.p ^ 2 * t.Q₁ l - 1) * ((t.point l).equation + t.p ^ 3 * w)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Cylinder.Frame.equation_point
statement:
lemma equation_point (t : Frame R) (l : R) :
    (t.point l).equation = l - t.p * t.u + t.p ^ 2 * t.Q l + t.p ^ 4 * t.f l ^ 3

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Cylinder.Frame.frame_point

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Cylinder.Frame.h_coordinates

lemma h_coordinates (t : Frame R) (z : R) :

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Cylinder.Frame.linear_point

lemma component_exists {D : Derivation k R R} (hD : D ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.filtration_mono
statement: lemma filtration_mono {d e : ℤ} (h : d ≤ e) : filtration G d ≤ filtration G e

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.highest
statement:
theorem highest [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ r : R, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : R → R)^[n] r = 0) :
    ∃ j, component G D j ≠ 0 ∧ ShiftBound G D j ∧
      ∀ r : R, ∃ n : ℕ, (component G D j : R → R)^[n] r = 0

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.homogeneous_generators
statement:
lemma homogeneous_generators [Algebra.FiniteType k R] :
    ∃ s : Finset R, Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set R) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ r ∈ s, ∃ i, r ∈ G i

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.iterate_top
statement:
lemma iterate_top {D : Derivation k R R} {j : ℤ} (hD : ShiftBound G D j)
    {r : R} {i : ℤ} (hr : r ∈ G i) (n : ℕ) :
    (D : R → R)^[n] r ∈ filtration G (i+n*j) ∧
    proj G (i+n*j) ((D : R → R)^[n] r) = ((component G D j : R → R)^[n] r)

statement:
lemma mem_filtration {r : R} {i d : ℤ} (hr : r ∈ G i) (hid : i ≤ d) :

statement:

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.proj_filtration

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.proj_mem

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedLND.proj_mul_left

statement:

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedMap.mvpolynomial
statement:
lemma mvpolynomial {ι : Type*} (G : ℤ → Submodule k R) [GradedAlgebra G]
    (w : ι → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] R)
    (hX : ∀ i, f (X i) ∈ G (w i)) {p : MvPolynomial ι k} {e : ℤ}

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedMap.projection
statement:
lemma projection (G : ℤ → Submodule k R) (H : ℤ → Submodule k S)

    (hf : ∀ e r, r ∈ G e → f r ∈ H e) (e : ℤ) (r : R) :
    f (GradedAlgebra.proj G e r)=GradedAlgebra.proj H e (f r)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.GradedMap.reflect
statement:
lemma reflect (G : ℤ → Submodule k R) (H : ℤ → Submodule k S)

    {e : ℤ} {r : R} (hr : f r ∈ H e) : r ∈ G e

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.SL2.no_negative_highest
statement:
lemma no_negative_highest (δ η H : R →ₗ[ℂ] R)
    (hcomm : ∀ r, δ (η r) - η (δ r) = H r)
    (hlower : ∀ r, H (η r) = η (H r) - (2 : ℂ) • η r)
    (r : R) (w : ℤ) (hw : w < 0) (hδ : δ r = 0)
    (hH : H r = (w : ℂ) • r) (hη : ∃ n : ℕ, (η : R → R)^[n] r = 0) : r = 0

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.DerivationIntertwining.mvPolynomial
statement:
lemma mvPolynomial (f : R →ₐ[k] S) (D : Derivation k R R) (E : Derivation k S S)
    {ι : Type*} (q : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] R) (p : MvPolynomial ι k)
    (hX : ∀ i, E (f (q (MvPolynomial.X i)))=f (D (q (MvPolynomial.X i)))) : E (f (q p))=f (D (q p))

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.inv_factorial_choose
statement:
lemma inv_factorial_choose [CharZero k] {n i j : ℕ} (h : i + j = n) :
    ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) * (n.choose i : k) =
      ((i.factorial : k)⁻¹) * ((j.factorial : k)⁻¹)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.iterate_add
statement:
lemma iterate_add (D : Derivation k R R) (n : ℕ) (r s : R) :
    (D : R → R)^[n] (r + s) = (D : R → R)^[n] r + (D : R → R)^[n] s

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.iterate_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
lemma iterate_eq_zero_of_le (D : Derivation k R R) {r : R} {n m : ℕ}
    (h : (D : R → R)^[n] r = 0) (hnm : n ≤ m) : (D : R → R)^[m] r = 0

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.iterate_smul
statement:
lemma iterate_smul (D : Derivation k R R) (n : ℕ) (c : k) (r : R) :
    (D : R → R)^[n] (c • r) = c • (D : R → R)^[n] r

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.iterate_zero
statement: lemma iterate_zero (D : Derivation k R R) (n : ℕ) : (D : R → R)^[n] 0 = 0

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_add
statement:
lemma orbit_add (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) (r s : R) :
    orbit D hD (r + s) = orbit D hD r + orbit D hD s

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_algebraMap
statement:
lemma orbit_algebraMap (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) (c : k) :
    orbit D hD (algebraMap k R c) = C (algebraMap k R c)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_constant_iff
statement:
lemma orbit_constant_iff (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) (r : R) :
    orbit D hD r = C r ↔ D r = 0

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_degree_le_one
statement:
lemma orbit_degree_le_one (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) {r : R}
    (hr : D (D r) = 0) : (orbit D hD r).natDegree ≤ 1

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_injective
statement:
lemma orbit_injective (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) :
    Function.Injective (orbit D hD)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_mul
statement:
lemma orbit_mul [CharZero k] (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) (r s : R) :
    orbit D hD (r * s) = orbit D hD r * orbit D hD s

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.orbit_support_finite
statement:
lemma orbit_support_finite (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) (r : R) :
    (Function.support (fun n : ℕ => ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : R → R)^[n] r)).Finite

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Rigidity.isUnit_of_square_dvd
statement:
lemma isUnit_of_square_dvd {n t : k[X]} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hdeg : n.natDegree ≤ 1)
    (ht : t ^ 2 ∣ n) : IsUnit t

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Rigidity.orbit_coprime
statement:
lemma orbit_coprime {a d u n : k[X]} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hdeg : n.natDegree ≤ 1)
    (heq : d ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * u ^ 3 = n) : IsCoprime (d ^ 2) (a ^ 2 * u ^ 3)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Rigidity.radical_orbit_bound
statement:
lemma radical_orbit_bound [DecidableEq k] (a d u n : k[X]) :
    (radical (d ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 * u ^ 3) * (-n))).natDegree ≤
    d.natDegree + a.natDegree + u.natDegree + n.natDegree

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Rigidity.ratFunc_X_cube_nonsquare
statement:
theorem ratFunc_X_cube_nonsquare {K : Type*} [Field K] (z : RatFunc K) :
    z ^ 2 ≠ -(RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ 3

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.Rigidity.ratFunc_intDegree_pow
statement:
lemma ratFunc_intDegree_pow {K : Type*} [Field K] {z : RatFunc K}
    (hz : z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : (z ^ n).intDegree = (n : ℤ) * z.intDegree

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.fixed_of_square_cube
statement:
theorem fixed_of_square_cube (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D)
    (f : R →ₐ[k] K) (hf : Function.Injective f) {a d u : R}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hn : d ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * u ^ 3 ≠ 0)
    (hlin : D (D (d ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * u ^ 3)) = 0)
    (hns : ∀ z : K, z ^ 2 ≠ -(f u) ^ 3) : D a = 0 ∧ D d = 0 ∧ D u = 0

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.derivative_orbit
statement:
lemma derivative_orbit (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) (r : R) :

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.fixed_of_dvd
statement:
lemma fixed_of_dvd (D : Derivation k R R) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D)

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.inv_factorial_succ
statement:
lemma inv_factorial_succ (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.ComplexCancellation.LND.kernel_factorially_closed
statement:

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.deriv_one
statement: @[simp] theorem deriv_one (f : α → A R α) : deriv f 1 = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.dualLift_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualLift_base (f : α → A R α) (p : A R α) :
    (dualLift f p).fst = p

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.embed_of
statement: @[simp] theorem embed_of (a : α) : embed (FreeLieAlgebra.of R a) = atom a

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.embed_shift
statement: theorem embed_shift (p : Elimination.F R α) : embed (Elimination.shift p) = shift (embed p)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom_ext {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] {f g : A R α →ₐ[R] B}
    (h : ∀ a, f (atom a) = g (atom a)) : f=g

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.leftMul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem leftMul_apply (p q : A R α) : leftMul p q = p*q

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.lift_atom
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_atom {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] (f : α → B) (a : α) :
    lift (R := R) f (atom a) = f a

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.shift_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_atom (i : ℕ) (a : α) : shift (atom (i,a) : A R (ℕ×α)) = atom (i+1,a)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.shift_mul
statement: theorem shift_mul (p q : A R (ℕ×α)) : shift (p*q) = shift p*q + p*shift q

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeElimination.shift_one
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_one : shift (1 : A R (ℕ×α)) = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.act_embed
statement: @[simp] theorem act_embed (p q : FL α) : act (embed p) q = ⁅p,q⁆

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.act_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem act_single (w : FreeMonoid α) (c : ℚ) :
    act (MonoidAlgebra.single w c) = c • wordAct w

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.centralizer_generator
statement:
theorem centralizer_generator {p : FL α} (b : α) (h : ⁅FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ b,p⁆ = 0) :
    p ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ b}

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.coeff_contains_ne
statement:
theorem coeff_contains_ne {P : A α} {b a : α} (h : atom b * P = P * atom b)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (u v : List α) : P.coeff (FreeMonoid.ofList (u ++ a :: v)) = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.coeff_eq_zero_of_letter_ne
OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.coeff_rotate
statement:
theorem coeff_rotate {P : A α} {b : α} (h : atom b * P = P * atom b) (w : List α) :
    P.coeff (FreeMonoid.ofList (b :: w)) = P.coeff (FreeMonoid.ofList (w ++ [b]))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.coeff_starts_ne
statement:
theorem coeff_starts_ne {P : A α} {b a : α} (h : atom b * P = P * atom b)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (v : List α) : P.coeff (FreeMonoid.ofList (a :: v)) = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.dynkinWord_all_eq
statement:
theorem dynkinWord_all_eq (b : α) (w : List α) (hw : ∀ a ∈ w, a = b) :
    dynkinWord w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ b}

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.dynkinWord_append
statement:
theorem dynkinWord_append (u v : List α) (hv : v ≠ []) :
    dynkinWord (u++v) = wordAct (FreeMonoid.ofList u) (dynkinWord v)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.dynkinWord_cons
statement:
theorem dynkinWord_cons (a : α) (w : List α) (hw : w ≠ []) :
    dynkinWord (a::w) = ⁅FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ a, dynkinWord w⁆

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.dynkin_embed_word
OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.dynkin_mul
statement:
theorem dynkin_mul {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 0) (a : A α) {b : A α}
    (hb : b ∈ homogeneous n) : dynkin (a*b) = act a (dynkin b)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.embed_injective
statement: theorem embed_injective : Function.Injective (embed (α := α))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.embed_of
statement: @[simp] theorem embed_of (a : α) : embed (FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ a) = atom a

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.mem_word_span
statement:
theorem mem_word_span (wt : α → ℕ) (p : FL α) :
    p ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {q | ∃ n, WeightedWord wt n q}

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.mul_homogeneous
statement:
theorem mul_homogeneous {n m : ℕ} {a b : A α}
    (ha : a ∈ homogeneous n) (hb : b ∈ homogeneous m) : a*b ∈ homogeneous (n+m)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.normalizedDynkin_embed
statement: theorem normalizedDynkin_embed (p : FL α) : normalizedDynkin (embed p) = p

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.normalizedDynkin_embed_word
statement:
theorem normalizedDynkin_embed_word {n : ℕ} {p : FL α}
    (hp : WeightedWord (fun _ : α => 1) n p) : normalizedDynkin (embed p) = p

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.normalizedDynkin_homogeneous
statement:
theorem normalizedDynkin_homogeneous {n : ℕ} {a : A α}
    (ha : a ∈ homogeneous n) : normalizedDynkin a = (n : ℚ)⁻¹ • dynkin a

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.single_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem single_mem_homogeneous (w : FreeMonoid α) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : w.toList.length = n) : MonoidAlgebra.single w 1 ∈ homogeneous (α := α) n

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.wordAct_of_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordAct_of_apply (a : α) (q : FL α) :
    wordAct (FreeMonoid.of a) q = ⁅FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ a,q⁆

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.AssociativeModel.wordLinear_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordLinear_single {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    (f : FreeMonoid α → M) (w : FreeMonoid α) (c : ℚ) :
    wordLinear f (MonoidAlgebra.single w c) = c • f w

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_antisymmetry
statement:
theorem cast_antisymmetry (q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool) :
    IntegralBaseChange.lie (S:=S) (antisymmetry q)=antisymmetry (IntegralBaseChange.lie q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_eval_braid
statement:
theorem cast_eval_braid (a b : GenericBraid.T ℤ (Fin 4)) (q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool) :
    GenericBraid.cast (S:=S) (eval a b q)=
      eval (R:=S) (GenericBraid.cast a) (GenericBraid.cast b) (IntegralBaseChange.lie q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_eval_lie
statement:
theorem cast_eval_lie (a b q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool) :
    IntegralBaseChange.lie (S:=S) (eval a b q)=
      eval (R:=S) (IntegralBaseChange.lie a) (IntegralBaseChange.lie b) (IntegralBaseChange.lie q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_pentagon
statement:
theorem cast_pentagon (q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool) :
    GenericBraid.cast (S:=S) (pentagon q)=pentagon (IntegralBaseChange.lie q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_threeTerm
statement:
theorem cast_threeTerm (q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool) :
    IntegralBaseChange.lie (S:=S) (threeTerm q)=threeTerm (IntegralBaseChange.lie q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_x
statement: @[simp] theorem cast_x : IntegralBaseChange.lie (x : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool)=(x : FreeLieAlgebra S Bool)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.cast_y
statement: @[simp] theorem cast_y : IntegralBaseChange.lie (y : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool)=(y : FreeLieAlgebra S Bool)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.eval_x
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_x {M : Type*} [LieRing M] [LieAlgebra R M] (a b : M) : eval (R:=R) a b x=a

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.eval_y
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_y {M : Type*} [LieRing M] [LieAlgebra R M] (a b : M) : eval (R:=R) a b y=b

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.integral_of_rational
statement:
theorem integral_of_rational (q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool)
    (hq : (IntegralBaseChange.lie q : L)∈W) : Equations q

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.pentagon_rational
statement: theorem pentagon_rational {q : L} (hq : q∈W) : pentagon q=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.rational
statement: theorem rational {q : L} (hq : q∈W) : Equations q

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BaseChangeEquations.reduce
statement:
theorem reduce (q : FreeLieAlgebra ℤ Bool)
    (hq : (IntegralBaseChange.lie q : L)∈W) : Equations (IntegralBaseChange.lie (S:=S) q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.chord_comm
statement: theorem chord_comm (i j : Fin 4) : chord i j = chord j i

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.chord_self
statement: @[simp] theorem chord_self (i : Fin 4) : chord i i = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.ideal_le_ker
statement: theorem ideal_le_ker : braidIdeal ≤ preMap.ker

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.inclusion_injective
statement: theorem inclusion_injective : Function.Injective inclusion

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.map_inclusion
statement: theorem map_inclusion : map.comp inclusion = LieAlgebra.SemiDirectSum.inl LieHom.id

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.map_t
statement: @[simp] theorem map_t (i j : Fin 4) : map (t i j) = chord i j

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidModel.preMap_chord
statement: @[simp] theorem preMap_chord (i j : Fin 4) : preMap (DeligneDrinfeld.chord i j) = chord i j

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.base_fiber
statement:
theorem base_fiber (i j k : α) :
    ⁅base (R := R) i j, fiber k⁆ = SemiDirectSum.inl LieHom.id
      (pair (R := R) i j (FreeLieAlgebra.of R k))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_comm
statement: theorem chord_comm (i j : Option α) : chord (R := R) i j = chord j i

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_disjoint
statement:
theorem chord_disjoint (i j k l : Option α)
    (hik : i ≠ k) (hil : i ≠ l) (hjk : j ≠ k) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    ⁅chord (R := R) i j, chord (R := R) k l⁆ = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_none_none
statement: @[simp] theorem chord_none_none : chord (R := R) (α := α) none none = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_none_some
statement: @[simp] theorem chord_none_some (j : α) : chord (R := R) none (some j) = fiber j

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_self
statement: @[simp] theorem chord_self (i : Option α) : chord (R := R) i i = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_some_none
statement: @[simp] theorem chord_some_none (i : α) : chord (R := R) (some i) none = fiber i

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_some_some
statement: @[simp] theorem chord_some_some (i j : α) : chord (R := R) (some i) (some j) = base i j

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.chord_three
statement:
theorem chord_three (i j k : Option α)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ⁅chord (R := R) i j, chord (R := R) i k + chord (R := R) j k⁆ = 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidRepresentation.fiber_base
statement:
theorem fiber_base (i j k : α) :
    ⁅fiber (R := R) k, base i j⁆ = - SemiDirectSum.inl LieHom.id
      (pair (R := R) i j (FreeLieAlgebra.of R k))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.H_homo
statement: theorem H_homo : H∈homogeneous fiberCount 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_C_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem J_C_one : J (C 1)=bracket (C 0) (C 1)+
    bracket (bracket (C 0) (Y 1)+bracket (Y 0) (C 1)) (Y 1)+bracket (Y 1) (bracket (X*X) (Y 0))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_C_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem J_C_zero : J (C 0)=bracket (C 0) (C 1)+
    bracket (bracket (C 0) (Y 1)+bracket (Y 0) (C 1)) (Y 0)+bracket (Y 0) (bracket (X*X) (Y 1))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_H
statement: @[simp] theorem J_H : J (X*X)=bracket (X*X) (bracket (Y 0) (Y 1))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_X
statement: @[simp] theorem J_X : J X=bracket (C 0) (Y 1)+bracket (Y 0) (C 1)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_Y_one
statement: @[simp] theorem J_Y_one : J (Y 1)=bracket (Y 1) (C 0)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_Y_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem J_Y_zero : J (Y 0)=bracket (Y 0) (C 1)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_bracket
statement: @[simp] theorem J_bracket (p q : A K G) : J (bracket p q)=bracket (J p) q+bracket p (J q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.J_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem J_mul (p q : A K G) : J (p*q)=J p*q+p*J q

statement: theorem Q_homo (i : Fin 2) : Q i∈homogeneous fiberCount 1

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.R_homo
statement: theorem R_homo (i : Fin 2) : R' i∈homogeneous fiberCount 1

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.U_homo
statement: theorem U_homo (i : Fin 2) : U i∈homogeneous fiberCount 1

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.V_homo
statement: theorem V_homo (i : Fin 2) : V i∈homogeneous fiberCount 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.W_homo
statement: theorem W_homo : W∈homogeneous fiberCount 1

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_X_C

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_X_Y

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_ad_square
statement: theorem bracket_ad_square (u v : A K G) : bracket u (bracket u v)=bracket (u*u) v

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_add_left
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_add_left (p q r : A K G) : bracket (p+q) r=bracket p r+bracket q r

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_add_right
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_add_right (p q r : A K G) : bracket p (q+r)=bracket p q+bracket p r

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_homo

statement: theorem bracket_leibniz (p q r : A K G) : bracket p (bracket q r)=bracket (bracket p q) r+bracket q (bracket p r)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_self
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_self (r : A K G) : bracket r r=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_sub_left
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_sub_left (p q r : A K G) : bracket (p-q) r=bracket p r-bracket q r

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_sub_right
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_sub_right (p q r : A K G) : bracket p (q-r)=bracket p q-bracket p r

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_swap
statement: theorem bracket_swap (p q : A K G) : bracket p q=bracket q p

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_zero_left (r : A K G) : bracket 0 r=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.bracket_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_zero_right (r : A K G) : bracket r 0=0

statement: theorem common_homo_2 (a : F) : common 2 a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount 2+fiberCount a)

statement: theorem common_homo_3 (a : F) : common 3 a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount 3+fiberCount a)

statement:

    deriv f (bracket p q)=bracket (deriv f p) q+bracket p (deriv f q)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.higher_homo
statement: theorem higher_homo (b : B) (a : F) : higher b a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount b+fiberCount a+2)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.higher_homo_0
statement: theorem higher_homo_0 (a : F) : higher 0 a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount 0+fiberCount a+2)

statement: theorem higher_homo_1 (a : F) : higher 1 a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount 1+fiberCount a+2)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.higher_homo_2
statement: theorem higher_homo_2 (a : F) : higher 2 a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount 2+fiberCount a+2)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.higher_homo_3
statement: theorem higher_homo_3 (a : F) : higher 3 a∈homogeneous fiberCount (baseCount 3+fiberCount a+2)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.realize_atom_three
statement: @[simp] theorem realize_atom_three : realize (atom (3 : F))=C 0

statement: theorem source_above (b : B) (a : F) : source b a∈above fiberCount (baseCount b+fiberCount a)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.CountTables.source_comparison
statement:
theorem source_comparison {n : ℕ} {p : A K (Sum F B)}
    (hp : p∈homogeneous (Sum.elim fiberCount baseCount) n) :
    PolynomialOrdering.normalize common p∈TensorGrading.homogeneous fiberCount baseCount n ∧
    PolynomialOrdering.normalize source p-PolynomialOrdering.normalize common p∈TensorGrading.above fiberCount baseCount (n+1)

theorem source_difference (b : B) (a : F) :

statement:
theorem target_comparison {n : ℕ} {p : A K (Sum F B)}

    PolynomialOrdering.normalize target p-PolynomialOrdering.normalize common p∈TensorGrading.strictlyBelow fiberCount baseCount n

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.comm_cons
statement:
theorem comm_cons (ν μ : α → α → R) (l r a b : α) (s : List α) :
    op μ l r (op ν l r (word (a::b::s)))-op ν l r (op μ l r (word (a::b::s)))=
      curvature ν μ l a b (s.headD r) • word s+
        atom a*(op μ a r (op ν a r (word (b::s)))-op ν a r (op μ a r (word (b::s))))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.commute_of_curvature
statement:
theorem commute_of_curvature (ν μ : α → α → R)
    (hc : ∀ l a b c,curvature ν μ l a b c=0) (l r : α) : ⁅op μ l r,op ν l r⁆=0

statement:

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.op_cons
statement:
theorem op_cons (ν : α → α → R) (l r a : α) (s : List α) :
    op ν l r (word (a::s))=(ν a (s.headD r)-ν l a) • word s+atom a*op ν a r (word s)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.op_list_sum

theorem op_list_sum {ι : Type*} (ν : ι → α → α → R) (s : List ι) (l r : α) :
    op (fun a b => (s.map (fun i => ν i a b)).sum) l r=(s.map (fun i => op (ν i) l r)).sum

statement: @[simp] theorem op_one (ν : α → α → R) (l r : α) : op ν l r 1=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.op_two
statement:
theorem op_two (ν : α → α → R) (l r a b : α) (p : A R α) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem op_word (ν : α → α → R) (l r : α) (s : List α) :

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.op_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem op_zero (l r : α) : op (fun _ _ => (0 : R)) l r=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.raw_add
statement:
theorem raw_add (ν μ : α → α → R) (l r : α) (s : List α) :

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Differentiation.slope_G
statement:
theorem slope_G (p : L) (a b t : M) :
    slope (G p) a b t 0 =
      ⁅t,eval b a p-eval b (-a-b) p⁆ +
      ⁅a,slope p b a 0 t⁆ - ⁅-a-b,slope p b (-a-b) 0 t⁆

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Differentiation.slope_G_formula
statement:
theorem slope_G_formula {n : ℕ} {p : L} {k : ℚ} (hp : p ∈ W) (hpn : p ∈ Ln n)
    (hn : 1<n) (hdiag : DiagonalData n p 0 k) (a b t : M) :
    slope (G p) a b t 0 = - k • (adPower a n t-adPower (-a-b) n t)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Differentiation.transverse
statement:
theorem transverse {n : ℕ} {p : L} {k : ℚ} (hp : p ∈ W) (hpn : p ∈ Ln n)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.commSum_apply
statement:
theorem commSum_apply (ν : ι → α → α → R) (pairs : List (ι×ι)) (l r : α) (p : A R α) :
    commSum ν pairs l r p=
      (pairs.map (fun ij => op (ν ij.2) l r (op (ν ij.1) l r p)-
        op (ν ij.1) l r (op (ν ij.2) l r p))).sum

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.commSum_cons
statement:
theorem commSum_cons (ν : ι → α → α → R) (pairs : List (ι×ι))
    (l r a b : α) (s : List α) :
    commSum ν pairs l r (word (a::b::s))=
      (pairs.map (fun ij => curvature (ν ij.1) (ν ij.2) l a b (s.headD r))).sum • word s+
        atom a*commSum ν pairs a r (word (b::s))

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Deletion.commSum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem commSum_eq_zero (ν : ι → α → α → R) (pairs : List (ι×ι))
    (hc : ∀ l a b c,(pairs.map (fun ij => curvature (ν ij.1) (ν ij.2) l a b c)).sum=0)
    (l r : α) : commSum ν pairs l r=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.EmbeddedTerminal.raw_snoc
statement:
theorem raw_snoc (enc : α → β) (hi : Function.Injective enc) (r : β)
    (hr : ∀ a,enc a≠r) (k a : α) (l : β) (s : List α) :
    raw (κ (R:=R) enc r k) l r ((s++[a]).map enc)=
      if k=a then word (FreeMonoid.ofList (s.map enc)) else 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.EmbeddedTerminal.scalar_word
statement:
theorem scalar_word (enc : α → β) (hi : Function.Injective enc) (l r : β)
    (hr : ∀ a,enc a≠r) (w s : List α) :
    scalar (κ (R:=R) enc r) l r (FreeMonoid.ofList (s.map enc)) (word (FreeMonoid.ofList w)) =
      if w=s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.EmbeddedTerminal.test
statement:
theorem test (enc : α → β) (hi : Function.Injective enc) (l r : β)
    (hr : ∀ a,enc a≠r) (p : A R α) (s : List α) :
    scalar (κ (R:=R) enc r) l r (FreeMonoid.ofList (s.map enc)) p=p.coeff (FreeMonoid.ofList s)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.PolynomialOrdering.iterated_comparison_above
statement:
theorem iterated_comparison_above (f g : A R β →ₗ[R] A R β)
    (hg : ∀ n p,p∈homogeneous wb n → g p∈homogeneous wb n)
    (hf : ∀ n p,p∈above wb n → f p∈above wb n)
    (hfg : ∀ n p,p∈homogeneous wb n → f p-g p∈above wb (n+1))
    (h0 : ∀ b a,δ₀ b a∈homogeneous wa (wb b+wa a))
    (hδ : ∀ b a,δ b a∈above wa (wb b+wa a))
    (hd : ∀ b a,δ b a-δ₀ b a∈above wa (wb b+wa a+1))
    {n : ℕ} {p : A R (Sum α β)} (hp : p∈homogeneous (Sum.elim wa wb) n) :
    iterated δ₀ g p∈homogeneous (Sum.elim wa wb) n ∧
    iterated δ f p-iterated δ₀ g p∈above (Sum.elim wa wb) (n+1)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.PolynomialOrdering.iterated_comparison_below
statement:

    (hg : ∀ n p,p∈homogeneous wb n → g p∈homogeneous wb n)
    (hf : ∀ n p,p∈below wb n → f p∈below wb n)
    (hfg : ∀ n p,p∈homogeneous wb n → f p-g p∈strictlyBelow wb n)
    (h0 : ∀ b a,δ₀ b a∈homogeneous wa (wb b+wa a))
    (hδ : ∀ b a,δ b a∈below wa (wb b+wa a))
    (hd : ∀ b a,δ b a-δ₀ b a∈strictlyBelow wa (wb b+wa a))
    {n : ℕ} {p : A R (Sum α β)} (hp : p∈homogeneous (Sum.elim wa wb) n) :
    iterated δ₀ g p∈homogeneous (Sum.elim wa wb) n ∧
    iterated δ f p-iterated δ₀ g p∈strictlyBelow (Sum.elim wa wb) n

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TargetDeletion.action_table
statement:
theorem action_table
    (hc : ∀ b a l x y z,((pairs b a).map
      (fun ij => Deletion.curvature (ν ij.1) (ν ij.2) l x y z)).sum=0)
    (l r : α) (b : B) (a : F) :
    evalBase ν l r (atom b)*evalFiber ν l r (atom a)-
      evalFiber ν l r (atom a)*evalBase ν l r (atom b)=evalFiber ν l r (CountTables.target b a)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TargetDeletion.evalBase_atom
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalBase_atom (l r : α) (b : B) :
    evalBase ν l r (atom b)=Deletion.op (ν (.inr b)) l r

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TargetDeletion.evalFiber_atom
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalFiber_atom (l r : α) (a : F) :
    evalFiber ν l r (atom a)=Deletion.op (ν (.inl a)) l r

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TargetDeletion.sum_extra
statement:
theorem sum_extra (l r : α) (b : B) (a : F) :
    (((extra b a).map (fun ij : F×F =>
      ⁅Deletion.op (ν (.inl ij.1)) l r,Deletion.op (ν (.inl ij.2)) l r⁆)).sum)=
    evalFiber ν l r (CountTables.target b a)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TargetDeletion.table_curvature
statement:
theorem table_curvature (b : B) (a : F) : ∀ l x y z : Letter,
    ((pairs b a).map (fun ij => Deletion.curvature (ν ij.1) (ν ij.2) l x y z)).sum=0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TargetDeletion.target_eq
statement:
theorem target_eq (b : B) (a : F) : CountTables.target b a=
    ((extra b a).map (fun ij => CountTables.bracket (atom ij.1) (atom ij.2))).sum

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TerminalDeletion.raw_snoc
statement:
theorem raw_snoc (k a : α) (l : Option α) (s : List α) :
    raw (κ (R:=R) k) l none ((s++[a]).map some)=
      if k=a then word (FreeMonoid.ofList (s.map some)) else 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TerminalDeletion.scalar_word
statement:
theorem scalar_word (w s : List α) :
    (action (κ (R:=R)) none none (word (FreeMonoid.ofList w))
      (word (FreeMonoid.ofList (s.map some)))).coeff 1 = if w=s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.TerminalDeletion.test
statement:
theorem test (p : A R α) (s : List α) :
    (action (κ (R:=R)) none none p (word (FreeMonoid.ofList (s.map some)))).coeff 1=
      p.coeff (FreeMonoid.ofList s)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.action_congr_on
statement:
theorem action_congr_on (κ μ : β → α → α → α → R) (P : α → Prop)
    (he : ∀ k l a b,P l → P a → κ k l a b=μ k l a b) (l r : α) (hl : P l)
    (q : A R β) {p : A R α} (hp : p∈space (fun w => ∀ a∈w.toList,P a)) :
    action κ l r q p=action μ l r q p

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.action_count_lower
statement:
theorem action_count_lower (κ : β → α → α → α → R) (l r : α)
    (wt : α → ℕ) (cost : β → ℕ) (hc : ∀ b l a t,κ b l a t≠0 → cost b≤wt a)
    (w : FreeMonoid β) {n : ℕ} {p : A R α} (hp : p∈below wt n) :
    action κ l r (word w) p∈space (fun v => degree cost w+degree wt v≤n)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.action_word_above
statement:
theorem action_word_above (κ : β → α → α → α → R) (l r : α)

    (w : FreeMonoid β) {n : ℕ} {p : A R α} (hp : p∈above wt n) :
    action κ l r (word w) p∈above wt (n-degree cost w)

statement:

statement:

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.edge_op

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.edge_raw
statement:
theorem edge_raw (ν : α → α → R) (l r : α) (s : List α) :

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.exact_allocation
statement:
theorem exact_allocation (κ : β → α → α → α → R) (l r : α)
    (wt : α → ℕ) (cost : β → ℕ) (hc : ∀ b l a t,κ b l a t≠0 → wt a≤cost b)
    (w : FreeMonoid β) {n : ℕ} (hn : degree cost w≤n) {p : A R α} (hp : p∈homogeneous wt n) :
    action (cut κ wt cost) l r (word w) p∈homogeneous wt (n-degree cost w) ∧
    action κ l r (word w) p-action (cut κ wt cost) l r (word w) p∈above wt (n-degree cost w+1)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.exact_allocation_lower
statement:
theorem exact_allocation_lower (κ : β → α → α → α → R) (l r : α)
    (wt : α → ℕ) (cost : β → ℕ) (hc : ∀ b l a t,κ b l a t≠0 → cost b≤wt a)
    (w : FreeMonoid β) {n : ℕ} {p : A R α} (hp : p∈homogeneous wt n) :
    action (cut κ wt cost) l r (word w) p∈space (fun v => degree cost w+degree wt v=n) ∧
    action κ l r (word w) p-action (cut κ wt cost) l r (word w) p∈
      space (fun v => degree cost w+degree wt v<n)

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.exact_allocation_lower_test
statement:
theorem exact_allocation_lower_test (κ : β → α → α → α → R) (l r : α)
    (wt : α → ℕ) (cost : β → ℕ) (hc : ∀ b l a t,κ b l a t≠0 → cost b≤wt a)
    (w : FreeMonoid β) {p : A R α} (hp : p∈homogeneous wt (degree cost w)) :
    (action κ l r (word w) p).coeff 1=(action (cut κ wt cost) l r (word w) p).coeff 1

name: OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedDeletion.exact_allocation_test
statement:
theorem exact_allocation_test (κ : β → α → α → α → R) (l r : α)
    (wt : α → ℕ) (cost : β → ℕ) (hc : ∀ b l a t,κ b l a t≠0 → wt a≤cost b)
    (w : FreeMonoid β) {p : A R α} (hp : p∈homogeneous wt (degree cost w)) :
    (action κ l r (word w) p).coeff 1=(action (cut κ wt cost) l r (word w) p).coeff 1

statement:
theorem count_transfer (wt : α → ℕ) (S C T : A R α →ₗ[R] A R α)
    (n : ℕ) (p e : A R α)

    (hSC : S p-C p∈above wt (n+1))
    (hTC : T p-C p∈strictlyBelow wt n)
    (hE : S e∈above wt (n+1)) (hzero : S (p+e)=0) :
    C p=0 ∧ T p∈strictlyBelow wt n

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.bezout_certificate
statement:
theorem bezout_certificate {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (h x y s : B) :
    Alpha x s*h + Beta x y s*y - 1 =
      (1 + 2*s^2*x)*(h - 1 - P x y s) - 4*s^4*(x^2 + y^3 - s*h)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.cusp

theorem cusp_universal {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (h u v w : B) :

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.shift

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.shift_universal

theorem shift_universal {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (x y s : B) :

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.compatibility
statement:
theorem compatibility (h x y s U G : B)
    (hc : x^2+y^3 = h*s) (hl : h*G-y*U = x) :
    y^2*(y+U^2) = h*(s-h*G^2+2*U*y*G)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.compatibility_identity
statement:
theorem compatibility_identity (h y s U G : B) :
    y^2*(y+U^2) - h*(s-h*G^2+2*U*y*G) =
      (h*G-y*U)^2 + y^3 - h*s

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.linear_parameter_inverse
statement:
theorem linear_parameter_inverse (h x y α β T : B) (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) :
    α*(h*T-β*x)+β*(y*T+α*x) = T

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.linear_parameter_relation
statement:
theorem linear_parameter_relation (h x y α β T : B) (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) :
    h*(y*T+α*x)-y*(h*T-β*x) = x

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.linear_to_original
statement:
theorem linear_to_original (h x y s U G W : B)
    (hl : h*G-y*U = x) (hw : h*W = y+U^2)
    (hs : y^2*W = s-h*G^2+2*U*y*G) :
    U^3+h*(G-U*W) = x ∧ -U^2+h*W = y ∧ S h U (G-U*W) W = s

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.original_to_linear
statement:
theorem original_to_linear (h x y s U V W : B)
    (hx : U^3+h*V = x) (hy : -U^2+h*W = y) (hs : S h U V W = s) :
    h*(V+U*W)-y*U = x ∧ h*W = y+U^2 ∧
      y^2*W = s-h*(V+U*W)^2+2*U*y*(V+U*W)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.recover_G
statement:
theorem recover_G (h x y α β U G : B)
    (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) (hl : h*G-y*U = x) :
    y*(α*U+β*G)+α*x = G

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.recover_U
statement:
theorem recover_U (h x y α β U G : B)
    (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) (hl : h*G-y*U = x) :
    h*(α*U+β*G)-β*x = U

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.solve_c
statement:
theorem solve_c (h c a b r q : B) (hc : c*a = h*b) (hb : r*h+q*c = 1) :
    c*(r*a+q*b) = b

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.solve_h
statement:
theorem solve_h (h c a b r q : B) (hc : c*a = h*b) (hb : r*h+q*c = 1) :
    h*(r*a+q*b) = a

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.solve_unique
statement:
theorem solve_unique (h c a b r q W : B) (hb : r*h+q*c = 1)
    (hh : h*W = a) (hy : c*W = b) : W = r*a+q*b

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.squared_bezout
statement:
theorem squared_bezout (h y α β : B) (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) :
    α*(1+β*y)*h + β^2*y^2 = 1

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.substitute_S
statement:
theorem substitute_S (h U G W : B) :
    S h U (G-U*W) W =
      h*G^2 - 2*U*(h*W-U^2)*G + (h*W-U^2)^2*W

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.inverse_parameter
statement:
theorem inverse_parameter (h x y s α β T : B) (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) :
    let U := inverseU h x β T
    let G := inverseG x y α T
    let W := inverseW h y s α β U G
    parameter α β U (inverseV U G W) W = T

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.inverse_relations
statement:
theorem inverse_relations (h x y s α β T : B)
    (hc : x^2+y^3 = h*s) (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) :
    let U := inverseU h x β T
    let G := inverseG x y α T
    let W := inverseW h y s α β U G
    U^3+h*inverseV U G W = x ∧ -U^2+h*W = y ∧ S h U (inverseV U G W) W = s

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.map_inverseG
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_inverseG (f : H) (x y α T : B) :
    f (inverseG x y α T) = inverseG (f x) (f y) (f α) (f T)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.map_inverseU

@[simp] theorem map_inverseU (f : H) (h x β T : B) :
    f (inverseU h x β T) = inverseU (f h) (f x) (f β) (f T)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.map_inverseV
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_inverseV (f : H) (U G W : B) :
    f (inverseV U G W) = inverseV (f U) (f G) (f W)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.map_inverseW
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_inverseW (f : H) (h y s α β U G : B) :
    f (inverseW h y s α β U G) =
      inverseW (f h) (f y) (f s) (f α) (f β) (f U) (f G)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.original_reconstruction
statement:
theorem original_reconstruction (h x y s α β U V W : B)
    (hb : α*h+β*y = 1) (hx : U^3+h*V = x)
    (hy : -U^2+h*W = y) (hs : S h U V W = s) :
    let T := parameter α β U V W
    let U' := inverseU h x β T
    let G' := inverseG x y α T
    let W' := inverseW h y s α β U' G'
    U' = U ∧ inverseV U' G' W' = V ∧ W' = W

statement:
theorem quotient_relations (h x y s : B) :

    let V := qvar h x y s 1
    let W := qvar h x y s 2
    U^3+c h*V = c x ∧ -U^2+c h*W = c y ∧ S (c h) U V W = c s

    (aeval (values h x y s α β)) (relS h s) = 0

theorem counterexample :
    Nonempty ((R ⧸ Ideal.span {F}) ≃ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ) ∧
    (∀ index : Fin 4, MvPolynomial.eval criticalPoint (MvPolynomial.pderiv index F) = 0) ∧
    MvPolynomial.eval criticalPoint F = -1 ∧
    (¬ ∃ (equiv : R ≃ₐ[ℂ] R) (index : Fin 4), equiv (MvPolynomial.X index) = F) ∧
    ∀ (dimension : ℕ) (bound : 4 ≤ dimension),
      Nonempty ((MvPolynomial (Fin dimension) ℂ ⧸ Ideal.span {extendedF bound}) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
        MvPolynomial (Fin (dimension - 1)) ℂ) ∧
      ¬ ∃ (equiv : MvPolynomial (Fin dimension) ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin dimension) ℂ)
        (index : Fin dimension), equiv (MvPolynomial.X index) = extendedF bound

        MvPolynomial (Fin (n - 1)) ℂ) ∧
      ¬ ∃ (equiv : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ)
        (index : Fin n), equiv (MvPolynomial.X index) = F

        4*s^4*(x^2 + y^3 - s*h)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.parameter_power_saturated
statement:
theorem parameter_power_saturated (a : R) (q : Polynomial ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (he : ambientParameter^n * a = Polynomial.aeval ambientParameter q) :
    a = Polynomial.aeval ambientParameter (parameterSlice a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.retract_power_saturated
statement:
theorem retract_power_saturated {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing B] (ι : B →+* A) (ρ : A →+* B)
    (hρι : ∀ b, ρ (ι b) = b) (b q : B) (a : A) (n : ℕ)
    (hb : ι b ≠ 0) (he : (ι b)^n * a = ι q) : a = ι (ρ a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.exists_aeval_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem exists_aeval_add_one_iff {K A : Type*} [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    (f a : A) :
    (∃ q : Polynomial K, a = Polynomial.aeval (f + 1) q) ↔
      ∃ q : Polynomial K, a = Polynomial.aeval f q

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameterSlice_aeval
statement:
theorem extendedParameterSlice_aeval {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (extendedParameterSlice hn).comp (Polynomial.aeval (extendedAmbientParameter hn)) =
      AlgHom.id ℂ (Polynomial ℂ)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameterSlice_aeval_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendedParameterSlice_aeval_apply {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (q : Polynomial ℂ) :
    extendedParameterSlice hn (Polynomial.aeval (extendedAmbientParameter hn) q) = q

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameterSlice_parameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendedParameterSlice_parameter {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    extendedParameterSlice hn (extendedAmbientParameter hn) = Polynomial.X

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameterSlice_rename
statement:
theorem extendedParameterSlice_rename {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (q : R) :
    extendedParameterSlice hn (MvPolynomial.rename (fourInclusion hn) q) = parameterSlice q

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameter_aeval_injective
statement:
theorem extendedParameter_aeval_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (Polynomial.aeval (extendedAmbientParameter hn) :
      Polynomial ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameter_laurent_intersection
statement:
theorem extendedParameter_laurent_intersection {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (L : Type*) [CommRing L] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) L]
    [IsLocalization.Away (extendedAmbientParameter hn) L] (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) :
    (∃ (m : ℕ) (q : Polynomial ℂ),
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) L (extendedAmbientParameter hn))^m *
          algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) L a =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) L (Polynomial.aeval (extendedAmbientParameter hn) q)) ↔
    a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({extendedF hn} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ))

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameter_localization_injective
statement:
theorem extendedParameter_localization_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (L : Type*) [CommRing L] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) L]
    [IsLocalization.Away (extendedAmbientParameter hn) L] :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) L)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameter_ne_zero
statement: theorem extendedParameter_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) : extendedAmbientParameter hn ≠ 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedParameter_power_saturated
statement:
theorem extendedParameter_power_saturated {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) (q : Polynomial ℂ) (m : ℕ)
    (he : (extendedAmbientParameter hn)^m * a = Polynomial.aeval (extendedAmbientParameter hn) q) :
    a = Polynomial.aeval (extendedAmbientParameter hn) (extendedParameterSlice hn a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coefficientMap_complex_intersection
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientMap_complex_intersection (a : ℂ) :
    coefficientMap (algebraMap ℂ LaurentCoefficients a) = algebraMap ℂ LocalizedAmbient a

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coefficientMap_intersection
statement:
theorem coefficientMap_intersection (r : R) :
    (∃ a : LaurentCoefficients, loc r = coefficientMap a) ↔
      ∃ q : Polynomial ℂ, r = Polynomial.aeval F q

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coefficientMap_intersection_adjoin
statement:
theorem coefficientMap_intersection_adjoin (r : R) :
    (∃ a : LaurentCoefficients, loc r = coefficientMap a) ↔
      r ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ ({F} : Set R)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coefficientMap_polynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientMap_polynomial (q : Polynomial ℂ) :
    coefficientMap (algebraMap (Polynomial ℂ) LaurentCoefficients q) =
      loc (Polynomial.aeval ambientC q)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.polynomialCoefficientMap_apply
statement:
theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_apply (q : Polynomial ℂ) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap q = loc (Polynomial.aeval ambientC q)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descendDerivation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem descendDerivation_apply (ι : A →ₐ[K] B) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (d : A → A) (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = D (ι a)) (a : A) :
    descendDerivation ι hι D d hd a = d a

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descendDerivation_commute
statement:
theorem descendDerivation_commute (ι : A →ₐ[K] B) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (D E : Derivation K B B) (d e : A → A)
    (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = D (ι a)) (he : ∀ a, ι (e a) = E (ι a))
    (hDE : ∀ b, D (E b) = E (D b)) (a : A) :
    descendDerivation ι hι D d hd (descendDerivation ι hι E e he a) =
      descendDerivation ι hι E e he (descendDerivation ι hι D d hd a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descendDerivation_iterate
statement:
theorem descendDerivation_iterate (ι : A →ₐ[K] B) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (d : A → A) (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = D (ι a))
    (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    ι ((descendDerivation ι hι D d hd : A → A)^[n] a) =
      (D : B → B)^[n] (ι a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descendDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem descendDerivation_locallyNilpotent (ι : A →ₐ[K] B) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (d : A → A) (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = D (ι a))
    (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) : LocallyNilpotent (descendDerivation ι hι D d hd)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.exists_descendDerivation
statement:
theorem exists_descendDerivation (ι : A →ₐ[K] B) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (hstable : ∀ a : A, ∃ b : A, ι b = D (ι a)) :
    ∃ d : Derivation K A A, ∀ a, ι (d a) = D (ι a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.scaleDerivation_commute
statement:
theorem scaleDerivation_commute (D E : Derivation K A A) (a b : A)
    (hDb : D b = 0) (hEa : E a = 0) (hDE : ∀ x, D (E x) = E (D x)) (x : A) :
    (a • D) ((b • E) x) = (b • E) ((a • D) x)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.scaleDerivation_iterate
statement:
theorem scaleDerivation_iterate (D : Derivation K A A) (c : A) (hc : D c = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    ((c • D : Derivation K A A) : A → A)^[n] a = c^n * (D : A → A)^[n] a

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.scaleDerivation_kernel
statement:
theorem scaleDerivation_kernel [IsDomain A] (D : Derivation K A A)
    (c : A) (hc : c ≠ 0) (a : A) : (c • D) a = 0 ↔ D a = 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.scaleDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem scaleDerivation_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation K A A) (c : A)
    (hc : D c = 0) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) : LocallyNilpotent (c • D)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.transportDerivation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem transportDerivation_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (a : A) :
    transportDerivation e D a = e.symm (D (e a))

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.transportDerivation_commute
statement:
theorem transportDerivation_commute (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B)
    (D E : Derivation K B B) (hDE : ∀ b, D (E b) = E (D b)) (a : A) :
    transportDerivation e D (transportDerivation e E a) =
      transportDerivation e E (transportDerivation e D a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.transportDerivation_iterate
statement:
theorem transportDerivation_iterate (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (transportDerivation e D : A → A)^[n] a = e.symm ((D : B → B)^[n] (e a))

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.transportDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem transportDerivation_locallyNilpotent (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B)
    (D : Derivation K B B) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) :
    LocallyNilpotent (transportDerivation e D)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coordinate_partial_iterate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coordinate_partial_iterate_eq_zero (i : σ) (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial σ B)
    (hp : ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, n ≤ m i → p.coeff m = 0) :
    (pderiv i : MvPolynomial σ B → MvPolynomial σ B)^[n] p = 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coordinate_partial_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem coordinate_partial_locallyNilpotent (i : σ) :
    LocallyNilpotent (pderiv i : Derivation B (MvPolynomial σ B) (MvPolynomial σ B))

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coordinate_partial_nilpotence_bound
statement:
theorem coordinate_partial_nilpotence_bound (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ B) :
    (pderiv i : MvPolynomial σ B → MvPolynomial σ B)^[
      p.support.sup (fun m => m i) + 1] p = 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.coordinate_partials_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem coordinate_partials_linearIndependent [Fintype σ] :
    LinearIndependent (MvPolynomial σ B)
      (fun i : σ => (pderiv i : Derivation B (MvPolynomial σ B) (MvPolynomial σ B)))

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.derivation_preserves_polynomial_image
statement:
theorem derivation_preserves_polynomial_image [Algebra K L]
    (ι : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] L) (D : Derivation K L L)
    (hX : ∀ j : σ, ∃ q : MvPolynomial σ K, ι q = D (ι (X j))) :
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ K, ∃ q : MvPolynomial σ K, ι q = D (ι p)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.exists_common_denominator_descent
statement:
theorem exists_common_denominator_descent (c : MvPolynomial σ K)
    [IsLocalization.Away c L]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L))
    (D : τ → Derivation K L L) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (d : τ → Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K) (MvPolynomial σ K)),
      ∀ (i : τ) (p : MvPolynomial σ K),
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L (d i p) =
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c)^N *
            D i (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L p)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.finite_localization_denominator_bound
statement:
theorem finite_localization_denominator_bound (c : MvPolynomial σ K)
    [IsLocalization.Away c L] (z : τ → σ → L) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ (i : τ) (j : σ), ∃ a : MvPolynomial σ K,
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L a =
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c)^N * z i j

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descended_commute
statement:
theorem descended_commute (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (N : ℕ) (D E : Derivation K L L) (d e : Derivation K A A)
    (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a))
    (he : ∀ a, ι (e a) = (ι c)^N * E (ι a))
    (hD : D (ι c) = 0) (hE : E (ι c) = 0)
    (hDE : ∀ a, D (E a) = E (D a)) (a : A) : d (e a) = e (d a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descended_fixes_parameter
statement:
theorem descended_fixes_parameter (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (N : ℕ) (D : Derivation K L L) (d : Derivation K A A)
    (hdesc : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a)) (hfix : D (ι c) = 0) :
    d c = 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descended_kernel
statement:
theorem descended_kernel (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (hu : IsUnit (ι c)) (N : ℕ)
    (D : Derivation K L L) (d : Derivation K A A)
    (hdesc : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a)) (a : A) :
    d a = 0 ↔ D (ι a) = 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descended_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem descended_linearIndependent [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι) (c : A)
    (hu : IsUnit (ι c)) (N : ℕ)
    (D : I → Derivation K L L) (d : I → Derivation K A A)
    (hdesc : ∀ i a, ι (d i a) = (ι c)^N * D i (ι a))
    (hfix : ∀ i, D i (ι c) = 0)
    (t : I → L) (ht : ∀ i j, D i (t j) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hfrac : ∀ j, ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : A), t j * (ι c)^n = ι r) :
    LinearIndependent A d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descended_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem descended_locallyNilpotent (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (N : ℕ) (D : Derivation K L L) (d : Derivation K A A)
    (hdesc : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a))
    (hfix : D (ι c) = 0) (hD : LocallyNilpotent D) : LocallyNilpotent d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_X2
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_X2 (c d : K) :

statement:
theorem backward_forward (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_freeAlpha (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_freeBeta
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_freeBeta (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_freeH
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_freeH (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    backward K c d (freeH K c d)=qH K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_freeS
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_freeS (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    backward K c d (freeS K d)=qS K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_freeX
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_freeX (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    backward K c d (freeX K d)=qX K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_freeY
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_freeY (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    backward K c d (freeY K d)=qY K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.backward_free_original
statement:
theorem backward_free_original (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    backward K c d (freeU K c d)=qU K c ∧
    backward K c d (freeV K c d)=qV K c ∧
    backward K c d (freeW K c d)=qW K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_h
statement: @[simp] theorem evaluation_h (c d : K) : evaluation K c d (rawH K)=freeH K c d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_relation
statement:
theorem evaluation_relation (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    evaluation K c d (relation K c)=0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_s
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_s (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    evaluation K c d (rawS K)=freeS K d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_u
statement: @[simp] theorem evaluation_u (c d : K) : evaluation K c d (rawU K)=freeU K c d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_v
statement: @[simp] theorem evaluation_v (c d : K) : evaluation K c d (rawV K)=freeV K c d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_w
statement: @[simp] theorem evaluation_w (c d : K) : evaluation K c d (rawW K)=freeW K c d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_x (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    evaluation K c d (rawX K)=freeX K d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.evaluation_y
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_y (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    evaluation K c d (rawY K)=freeY K d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.forward_backward
statement:
theorem forward_backward (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    (forward K c d hunit).comp (backward K c d)=AlgHom.id K _

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.forward_qmap
statement:
@[simp] theorem forward_qmap (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) (f) :
    forward K c d hunit (qmap K c f)=evaluation K c d f

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.free_bezout
statement:
theorem free_bezout (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    freeAlpha K c d*freeH K c d+freeBeta K c d*freeY K d=1

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.free_cusp
statement:
theorem free_cusp (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    (freeX K d)^2+(freeY K d)^3=freeS K d*freeH K c d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.free_relations
statement:
theorem free_relations (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    (freeU K c d)^3+freeH K c d*freeV K c d=freeX K d ∧
    -(freeU K c d)^2+freeH K c d*freeW K c d=freeY K d ∧
    S (freeH K c d) (freeU K c d) (freeV K c d) (freeW K c d)=freeS K d

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.quotient_bezout
statement:
theorem quotient_bezout (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    qAlpha K c d*qH K c+qBeta K c d*qY K c = 1

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.quotient_cusp
statement: theorem quotient_cusp (c : K) : (qX K c)^2+(qY K c)^3 = qS K c*qH K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.quotient_recover_s
statement:
theorem quotient_recover_s (c d : K) (hunit : c*d=1) :
    coeff K c d*((qX K c+(qS K c)^3)^2+(qY K c-(qS K c)^2)^3) = qS K c

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ParameterBridge.quotient_relation
statement:
theorem quotient_relation (c : K) :
    qH K c = coeff K c c+P (qX K c) (qY K c) (qS K c)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_c
statement: @[simp] theorem ambientToFree_c : ambientToFree ambientC = C coefficientC

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_constant
statement:
@[simp] theorem ambientToFree_constant (a : ℂ) :

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_h
statement:
@[simp] theorem ambientToFree_h :
    ambientToFree h = ParameterBridge.freeH LaurentCoefficients coefficientC coefficientD

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_s
statement: @[simp] theorem ambientToFree_s : ambientToFree s = ParameterBridge.freeS LaurentCoefficients coefficientD

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_shiftX
statement: @[simp] theorem ambientToFree_shiftX : ambientToFree shiftX = X 0

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_shiftY
statement: @[simp] theorem ambientToFree_shiftY : ambientToFree shiftY = X 1

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_u
statement:
@[simp] theorem ambientToFree_u :
    ambientToFree u = ParameterBridge.freeU LaurentCoefficients coefficientC coefficientD

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem ambientToFree_v :
    ambientToFree v = ParameterBridge.freeV LaurentCoefficients coefficientC coefficientD

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.ambientToFree_w

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.critical_aeval
statement:
theorem critical_aeval {σ B : Type*} [CommRing B]
    (f : MvPolynomial σ B) (point : σ → B)
    (hc : ∀ i, eval point (pderiv i f) = 0) (q : Polynomial B) (i : σ) :

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.element_of_extendedF_subring_not_coordinate
statement:
theorem element_of_extendedF_subring_not_coordinate {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.no_coordinate_aeval_of_critical

theorem no_coordinate_aeval_of_critical {σ B : Type*} [Fintype σ] [CommRing B]

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.mixed_descended_commute
statement:
theorem mixed_descended_commute (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (N M : ℕ) (D E : Derivation K L L) (d e : Derivation K A A)
    (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a))
    (he : ∀ a, ι (e a) = (ι c)^M * E (ι a))
    (hD : D (ι c) = 0) (hE : E (ι c) = 0)
    (hDE : ∀ a, D (E a) = E (D a)) (a : A) : d (e a) = e (d a)

name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.mixed_descended_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem mixed_descended_linearIndependent [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι) (c : A)
    (hu : IsUnit (ι c)) (N : I → ℕ)
    (D : I → Derivation K L L) (d : I → Derivation K A A)
    (hdesc : ∀ i a, ι (d i a) = (ι c)^(N i) * D i (ι a))
    (hfix : ∀ i, D i (ι c) = 0)
    (t : I → L) (ht : ∀ i j, D i (t j) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hfrac : ∀ j, ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : A), t j * (ι c)^n = ι r) :
    LinearIndependent A d

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.increment_lower
statement:
lemma increment_lower (h : DiscreteConvex F) (q k : ℕ) :

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.increment_mono
statement:
lemma increment_mono (h : DiscreteConvex F) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) :
    F (i+k) - F i ≤ F (j+k) - F j

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.increment_upper
statement:
lemma increment_upper (h : DiscreteConvex F) (q k r : ℕ) (hkr : q+k ≤ r+1) :
    F (q+k) - F q ≤ (k : ℝ) * (F (r+1) - F r)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.le_endpoint
statement:
lemma le_endpoint (h : DiscreteConvex F) (h0 : F 0 = 0)
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (hm : 0 < m) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hend : F m ≤ B) : F n ≤ B

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.of_step
statement:
lemma of_step (h : ∀ n, F (n+1) - F n ≤ F (n+2) - F (n+1)) :

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.secant_le
statement:
lemma secant_le (h : DiscreteConvex F) {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.slopes_tendsto
statement:
lemma slopes_tendsto (h : DiscreteConvex F) (h0 : F 0 = 0)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hq : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, δ * (n : ℝ)^2 ≤ F n) :
    Tendsto (fun n => F (n+1) - F n) atTop atTop

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.step
statement:
lemma step (h : DiscreteConvex F) (n : ℕ) :
    F (n+1) - F n ≤ F (n+2) - F (n+1)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.sub_zero_le
statement:
lemma sub_zero_le (h : DiscreteConvex F) (n : ℕ) :
    F n - F 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * (F (n+1) - F n)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.summable_exp_neg_slope
statement:
lemma summable_exp_neg_slope (h : DiscreteConvex F) (h0 : F 0 = 0)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hq : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, δ * (n : ℝ)^2 ≤ F n) :
    Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-(F (n+1) - F n)))

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.tail_summable
statement:
lemma tail_summable (h : DiscreteConvex F)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-(F (n+1) - F n))))
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) : Summable (normalizedTailTerm F q)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.tail_term_bound
statement:
lemma tail_term_bound (h : DiscreteConvex F) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (k : ℕ) :
    normalizedTailTerm F q k ≤
      Real.exp (F 1) * Real.exp (-(F (k+2) - F (k+1)))

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.tail_term_tendsto
statement:
lemma tail_term_tendsto (h : DiscreteConvex F)
    (hs : Tendsto (fun n => F (n+1) - F n) atTop atTop) (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun q => normalizedTailTerm F q k) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.DiscreteConvex.tail_tsum_tendsto
statement:
lemma tail_tsum_tendsto (h : DiscreteConvex F)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-(F (n+1) - F n))))
    (hs : Tendsto (fun n => F (n+1) - F n) atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun q => ∑' k, normalizedTailTerm F q k) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.large_curvature
statement:
lemma large_curvature {F : ℕ → ℝ} {lam μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hlamμ : lam < μ)
    (hq : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, μ * (n : ℝ)^2 ≤ F n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ 2*lam < F (n+2) - 2*F (n+1) + F n

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.quadratic_upper_of_curvature
statement:
lemma quadratic_upper_of_curvature {F : ℕ → ℝ} {lam : ℝ} (N : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, N ≤ n → F (n+2) - 2*F (n+1) + F n ≤ 2*lam) (k : ℕ) :
    F (N+k) ≤ F N + (k : ℝ) * (F (N+1) - F N) + lam * k * (k-1)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.central_norm
statement:
lemma central_norm (_ : EnvelopeBounds A B b c) {m p : ℕ}
    (hp : ‖b (p : ℤ)‖ = Real.exp (-B p))
    (hm : ‖c (-(m : ℤ))‖ = Real.exp (-A m)) :
    ‖centeredCorrelation b c m p 0‖ = Real.exp (-B p - A m)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.correlation_budget
statement:
lemma correlation_budget (hb : EnvelopeBounds A B b c)
    (hA : DiscreteConvex A) (hB : DiscreteConvex B)
    (hA0 : A 0 = 0) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (hsA : Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-(A (n+1) - A n))))
    (hsB : Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-(B (n+1) - B n))))
    {m p : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hp : 1 ≤ p) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hbridge₁ : A m - A (m-1) + lam ≤ B (p+1) - B p)
    (hbridge₂ : B p - B (p-1) + lam ≤ A (m+1) - A m)
    (hcB : ‖b (p : ℤ)‖ = Real.exp (-B p))
    (hcA : ‖c (-(m : ℤ))‖ = Real.exp (-A m))
    (hz : (∑' n : ℤ, centeredCorrelation b c m p n) = 0) :
    1 ≤ 2 * (∑' k, geometricMiddle lam k) +
      (∑' k, normalizedTailTerm A (m+p) k) +
      (∑' k, normalizedTailTerm B (m+p) k)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.middle_neg
statement:
lemma middle_neg (hb : EnvelopeBounds A B b c)
    (hA : DiscreteConvex A) (hB : DiscreteConvex B)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ p) {lam : ℝ}
    (hbridge : B p - B (p-1) + lam ≤ A (m+1) - A m) :
    ‖centeredCorrelation b c m p (-(k : ℤ))‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-B p - A m) * Real.exp (-lam * k)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.middle_pos
statement:
lemma middle_pos (hb : EnvelopeBounds A B b c)
    (hA : DiscreteConvex A) (hB : DiscreteConvex B)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (p k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) {lam : ℝ}
    (hbridge : A m - A (m-1) + lam ≤ B (p+1) - B p) :
    ‖centeredCorrelation b c m p k‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-B p - A m) * Real.exp (-lam * k)

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.reflected
statement:
lemma reflected (hb : EnvelopeBounds A B b c) :
    EnvelopeBounds B A (fun n => c (-n)) (fun n => b (-n)) where
  b_pos

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.tail_neg
statement:
lemma tail_neg (hb : EnvelopeBounds A B b c) (m p k : ℕ)
    (hend : B p + A m ≤ A (m+p)) :
    ‖centeredCorrelation b c m p (-((p+k+1 : ℕ) : ℤ))‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-B p - A m) * normalizedTailTerm A (m+p) k

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.EnvelopeBounds.tail_pos
statement:
lemma tail_pos (hb : EnvelopeBounds A B b c) (m p k : ℕ)
    (hend : B p + A m ≤ B (m+p)) :
    ‖centeredCorrelation b c m p ((m+k+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-B p - A m) * normalizedTailTerm B (m+p) k

name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.central_norm_le_of_correlation_zero
statement:
lemma central_norm_le_of_correlation_zero (f : ℤ → ℂ)
    (hp : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖f (n+1)‖))
    (hn : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖f (-(n+1))‖))
    (hz : (∑' n : ℤ, f n) = 0) :

      ‖c (-((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ))‖ = Real.exp (-A (n+1)))
    (hcB : ∀ n, 0 < B (n+2) - 2*B (n+1) + B n →
      ‖b ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)‖ = Real.exp (-B (n+1)))

    (hmiddle : ∀ k, k < m → g k ≤ M * t k)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sigma_apply

name: OAI.C0Absorption.selectedCoordinate_summable

name: OAI.C0Absorption.abs_realSign
statement: @[simp] theorem abs_realSign (b : Bool) : |realSign b| = 1

name: OAI.C0Absorption.coordinate_envelope_summable
statement:
theorem coordinate_envelope_summable {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (q : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ X)
    (hdom : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) x, ∑ d ∈ s, (q d x) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (m : ℕ → X) (M : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∀ n (ε : Fin n → Bool), ‖∑ i, realSign (ε i) • m i‖ ≤ M) :
    Summable (fun d => ⨆ i : ℕ, (q d (m i)) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ d i, (q d (m i)) ^ 2 ≤ ⨆ j : ℕ, (q d (m j)) ^ 2)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.exists_nonzero_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_coordinate {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (q : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ X)
    (hq : ∀ x, Summable (fun d => (q d x) ^ 2))
    (hnorm : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑' d, (q d x) ^ 2)
    (m : ℕ → X) (M r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hlower : ∀ i, r ≤ ‖m i‖)
    (hsum : ∀ n (ε : Fin n → Bool), ‖∑ i, realSign (ε i) • m i‖ ≤ M) :
    ∃ d, ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun i => q d (m i)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.finite_detector_bound
statement:
theorem finite_detector_bound {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n → X) (u : Fin n → X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (α M δ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (_hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hsum : ∀ ε : Fin n → Bool, ‖∑ i, realSign (ε i) • m i‖ ≤ M)
    (hdual : ∀ x, α * ∑ k, (u k x) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hdetect : ∀ i, δ ^ 2 ≤ (u i (m i)) ^ 2) :
    α * (n : ℝ) * δ ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.no_infinite_detectors
statement:
theorem no_infinite_detectors {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (m : ℕ → X) (u : ℕ → X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (α M δ : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsum : ∀ n (ε : Fin n → Bool), ‖∑ i, realSign (ε i) • m i‖ ≤ M)
    (hdual : ∀ n x, α * ∑ k : Fin n, (u k x) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hdetect : ∀ i, δ ≤ |u i (m i)|) : False

name: OAI.C0Absorption.realSign_false
statement: @[simp] theorem realSign_false : realSign false = -1

name: OAI.C0Absorption.realSign_not
statement: @[simp] theorem realSign_not (b : Bool) : realSign (!b) = -realSign b

name: OAI.C0Absorption.realSign_true
statement: @[simp] theorem realSign_true : realSign true = 1

name: OAI.C0Absorption.seminorm_sign_pair
statement:
theorem seminorm_sign_pair {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    (q : Seminorm ℝ X) {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → X) (ε : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) :
    2 * (q (m i)) ^ 2 ≤
      (q (∑ j, realSign (ε j) • m j)) ^ 2 +
      (q (∑ j, realSign (flipSign i ε j) • m j)) ^ 2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.signed_sum_sub_flip
statement:
theorem signed_sum_sub_flip {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → X) (ε : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) :
    (∑ j, realSign (ε j) • m j) - (∑ j, realSign (flipSign i ε j) • m j) =
      (2 * realSign (ε i)) • m i

name: OAI.C0Absorption.square_norm_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem square_norm_tendsto_zero {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (q : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ X)
    (hq : ∀ x, Summable (fun d => (q d x) ^ 2))
    (hnorm : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑' d, (q d x) ^ 2)
    (m : ℕ → X) (M : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∀ n (ε : Fin n → Bool), ‖∑ i, realSign (ε i) • m i‖ ≤ M)
    (hzero : ∀ d, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => q d (m i)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ‖m i‖ ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sum_ciSup_le_of_forall_choice
statement:
theorem sum_ciSup_le_of_forall_choice {ι κ : Type*} [Nonempty κ]
    (a : ι → κ → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (K : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ f : ι → κ, ∑ d ∈ s, a d (f d) ≤ K) :
    ∑ d ∈ s, ⨆ k, a d k ≤ K

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sum_coordinate_choice_le
statement:
theorem sum_coordinate_choice_le {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (q : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ X)
    (hdom : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) x, ∑ d ∈ s, (q d x) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (m : ℕ → X) (M : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∀ n (ε : Fin n → Bool), ‖∑ i, realSign (ε i) • m i‖ ≤ M)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (index : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ s, (q d (m (index d))) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sum_sign_seminorm_sq_ge
statement:
theorem sum_sign_seminorm_sq_ge {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    (q : Seminorm ℝ X) {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → X) (i : Fin n) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (q (m i)) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (q (∑ j, realSign (ε j) • m j)) ^ 2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sum_sign_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sign_sq (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∑ i, realSign (ε i) * a i) ^ 2 =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n * ∑ i, a i ^ 2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.exists_uniform_lp_detector
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_lp_detector (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [Fact (1 ≤ q)]
    (hp : 0 < p.toReal) (hq : 0 < q.toReal) (hqp : q.toReal < p.toReal)
    (a B : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hB : 0 < B) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
      a ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp p x‖ → ‖WithLp.toLp q x‖ ≤ B →
      ∃ i, δ < |x i|

name: OAI.C0Absorption.finite_lp_interpolation
statement:
theorem finite_lp_interpolation {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p q : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : 0 < p.toReal) (hq : 0 < q.toReal)
    (hqp : q.toReal < p.toReal) (x : ι → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ δ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp p x‖ ^ p.toReal ≤
      δ ^ (p.toReal - q.toReal) * ‖WithLp.toLp q x‖ ^ q.toReal

name: OAI.C0Absorption.finite_lp_norm_rpow
statement:
theorem finite_lp_norm_rpow {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

statement:
theorem tendsto_of_dense_lipschitz {A X Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]
    (d : A → X) (hd : DenseRange d) (f : ℕ → X → Y) (g : X → Y) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hf : ∀ n, LipschitzWith K (f n)) (hg : LipschitzWith K g)
    (h : ∀ a, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f n (d a)) Filter.atTop (nhds (g (d a))))

statement:

name: OAI.C0Absorption.completedPairing_tendsto
statement:
theorem completedPairing_tendsto (f : ℕ → S → ℝ) (g : S → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hbound : ∀ n (m : PreSpace L o), |pairing S (f n) m| ≤ K * ‖m‖)
    (hpoint : ∀ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f n s) Filter.atTop (nhds (g s))) :
    (∀ m : PreSpace L o, |pairing S g m| ≤ K * ‖m‖) ∧
    ∀ z : TestSpace L o,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => completedPairing L o (f n) z) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (completedPairing L o g z))

name: OAI.C0Absorption.exists_smaller_exponent

    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {B : Set E} (hB : Convex ℝ B)
    (n : ℕ) (u b : Fin n → B → ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ)
    (C : Fin n → Set B) (K : ℝ≥0) (Kb : Fin n → ℝ≥0)
    (_hu : ∀ i, Continuous (u i)) (hb : ∀ i, LipschitzWith (Kb i) (b i))
    (hF : ∀ i, LipschitzWith K (fun x => u i x * b i x))
    (hC : ∀ i, IsOpen (C i)) (hc : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ C i, u i x = e i)
    (hnest : ∀ i j, i < j → tsupport (u j) ⊆ C i)
    (ε : Fin n → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) :
    LipschitzWith (K + ∑ i, ‖e i‖₊ * Kb i)
      (fun x => ∑ i, ε i * (u i x * b i x))

name: OAI.C0Absorption.absorption_inverse_bound
statement:
theorem absorption_inverse_bound {E U Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup U] [NormedSpace ℝ U] [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
    (Q : Z →L[ℝ] U) (K : E × U → Z) (g : E × U → U)
    {LK cg : ℝ} (hLK : 0 ≤ LK) (hcg : 0 < cg)
    (hK : ∀ x y, dist (K x) (K y) ≤ LK * dist x y)
    (hg : ∀ x y, cg * dist x y ≤ dist (g x) (g y))
    (hQK : ∀ x : E × U, Q (K x) = g x-x.2) :
    ∀ x y, dist x y ≤ max (1+LK*‖Q‖/cg) (‖Q‖/cg) *
      dist (absorptionMap Q K x) (absorptionMap Q K y)

    (Q : Z →L[ℝ] U) (K : E × U → Z) {LK : ℝ}
    (hLK : 0 ≤ LK) (hK : ∀ x y, dist (K x) (K y) ≤ LK * dist x y) :
    ∀ x y, dist (absorptionMap Q K x) (absorptionMap Q K y) ≤

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.exists_flatten
statement:
theorem exists_flatten (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) (ts : List TailOperation)
    (h : ℕ) (hr : r.operations.length ≤ h) (hj : B.band γ ≤ h)
    (ht : ts.length ≤ h) (hs : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.scaleIndex ≤ h)
    (v : Cube (B.coordinates γ)) (z : SourceSpace B) {δ cap : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : 0 < cap) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (r' : GeneratedRepresentation B γ),
      dyadic a < cap ∧ r'.operations = r.operations++[flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v] ∧
      |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (fun s => r'.value s*tailProduct ts s) z-
        completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (fun s => r.value s*tailProduct ts s) z| < δ ∧
      (∀ s, dist (cubeRestrict (B.coordinates γ) s) v < 3*dyadic a/8 →
        r'.value s = r.cubeValue (flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v).point) ∧
      (∀ s, |r'.value s| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r.operations.length*B.A)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.exists_flatten_T
statement:
theorem exists_flatten_T (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ)
    (h : ℕ) (hr : r.operations.length ≤ h)
    (v : Cube (B.coordinates γ)) (z : SourceSpace B) {δ cap : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : 0 < cap) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (r' : GeneratedRepresentation B γ),
      dyadic a < cap ∧ r'.operations = r.operations++[flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v] ∧
      |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin r'.value z-
        completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin r.value z| < δ ∧
      (∀ s, dist (cubeRestrict (B.coordinates γ) s) v < 3*dyadic a/8 →
        r'.value s = r.cubeValue (flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v).point) ∧
      (∀ s, |r'.value s| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r.operations.length*B.A)

    (hselect : ∀ a (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ → ∃ ψ, StrictMono ψ ∧ P a (φ ∘ ψ)) :

name: OAI.C0Absorption.high_bands_compatible
statement:
theorem high_bands_compatible {Γ : Type*} {B : CylinderBases Γ} (loc : TagLocalization B)
    (γ : ℕ → Γ) (r : ∀ i, GeneratedRepresentation B (γ i)) (h : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).operations.length ≤ h)
    (hj : Tendsto (fun i => B.band (γ i)) atTop atTop)
    (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (r i).value (m i)|) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, F i ∈ TClass B (h+1)) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      ∀ n (ε : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, |ε i|=1) →
        LipschitzWith (4^(h+1)*B.L0+1) (fun s => ∑ i, ε i*F i s)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.nested_selection_lipschitz
statement:
theorem nested_selection_lipschitz {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : Convex ℝ S) (u b : ℕ → S → ℝ) (C : ℕ → Set S) (e : ℕ → ℝ)
    (K Kb : ℝ≥0) (hu : ∀ i, Continuous (u i)) (hb : ∀ i, LipschitzWith Kb (b i))
    (hF : ∀ i, LipschitzWith K (fun x => u i x*b i x))
    (hC : ∀ i, IsOpen (C i)) (hc : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ C i, u i x=e i)
    (hnest : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, tsupport (u j) ⊆ C i)
    (hsmall : Tendsto (fun i => |e i| *(Kb : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ n (ε : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, |ε i|=1) →
        LipschitzWith (K+1) (fun x => ∑ i, ε i * (u (φ i) x*b (φ i) x))

statement:
theorem low_bands_disjoint (γ : ℕ → Γ) (r : ∀ i, GeneratedRepresentation B (γ i))

    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).operations.length ≤ h) (hj : ∀ i, B.band (γ i)=j) (hjh : j ≤ h)
    (ht : ∀ i, (ts i).length ≤ h) (ha : ∀ i t, t ∈ ts i → t.scaleIndex ≤ h)
    (hγ : Function.Injective γ) (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin
      (fun s => (r i).value s*tailProduct (ts i) s) (m i)|) :
    ∃ H, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, F i ∈ VClass B H) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i k => Disjoint (tsupport (F i)) (tsupport (F k)))

name: OAI.C0Absorption.small_supports_compatible
statement:
theorem small_supports_compatible {Γ : Type*} {B : CylinderBases Γ} {γ : Γ}
    (r : ℕ → GeneratedRepresentation B γ) (ts : ℕ → List TailOperation) (h : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).operations.length ≤ h) (hj : B.band γ ≤ h)
    (ht : ∀ i, (ts i).length ≤ h) (ha : ∀ i t, t ∈ ts i → t.scaleIndex ≤ h)
    (q : ℕ → Cube (B.coordinates γ)) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (haPos : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (ha0 : Tendsto a atTop (nhds 0)) (hb0 : Tendsto b atTop (nhds 0))
    (hsup : ∀ i x, |(r i).cubeValue x| ≤ b i)
    (hsupp : ∀ i x, x ∈ tsupport (r i).cubeValue → dist x (q i) ≤ a i)
    (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin
      (fun s => (r i).value s*tailProduct (ts i) s) (m i)|) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, F i ∈ VClass B (h+1)) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      ∀ n (ε : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, |ε i|=1) →
        LipschitzWith (4^(h+1)*B.L0+(h+1)*4^(h+1)*B.A+1)
          (fun s => ∑ i, ε i*F i s)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tail_separation
statement:
theorem tail_separation {h : ℕ} (F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ) (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ∈ VClass B h) {δ cstar : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcstar : 0 < cstar)
    (hdetect : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m i)|)
    (M : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : Tendsto M atTop atTop)
    (hsupport : ∀ i s, s ∈ tsupport (F i) → cstar ≤ tau (M i) s.val) :
    ∃ H, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ G : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, G i ∈ VClass B H) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (G i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (G i)) (tsupport (G j)))

statement:
theorem heavy_tail_upper (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ j, Measurable (Y j))

    (hx : Integrable x μ) (hu : ∀ k, Integrable (u k) μ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) :
