name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_comparison_average
statement:
lemma trace_comparison_average {α : Type u3} [MeasurableSpace α] (ν : Measure α)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (U : α → unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (M D : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hU : Integrable (fun t ↦ conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (U t) D) ν)
    (hUs : Integrable (fun t ↦ conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (U t)) D) ν)
    (hsym : (∫ t, conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (U t)) D ∂ν) =
      ∫ t, conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (U t) D ∂ν)
    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ t ∂ν, 0 ≤ (trace (M * (2 • D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (U t) D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (U t)) D))).re) :
    (trace (M * (∫ t, conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (U t) D ∂ν))).re ≤
      (trace (M * D)).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_conjugate_difference
statement:
lemma trace_conjugate_difference (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (F A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace ((conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U F - F) * (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A - A)) =
      trace (F * (2 • A - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) A))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_conjugate_pair
statement:
lemma trace_conjugate_pair (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (F A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U F * A) =
      trace (F * conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) A)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_functional_monotonicity
OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_star_mul_change
statement:
lemma trace_star_mul_change (U V : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace (star (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) *
      (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * B * (V : Matrix n n ℂ))) = trace (star A * B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_star_mul_sum
statement:
lemma trace_star_mul_sum (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (trace (star A * B)).re = ∑ i, ∑ j, (star (A i j) * B i j).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_unitary_comparison
statement:
lemma trace_unitary_comparison {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    0 ≤ (trace (hA.cfc f * (2 • A - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) A))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_unitary_comparison_limit
statement:
lemma trace_unitary_comparison_limit {ι : Type u2} {l : Filter ι} [l.NeBot]
    {F : ι → Matrix n n ℂ} {M D : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hlim : Filter.Tendsto F l (nhds M)) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hF : ∀ᶠ i in l, 0 ≤ (trace (F i * (2 • D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) D))).re) :
    0 ≤ (trace (M * (2 • D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) D))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_unitary_comparison_sub_invariant
statement:
lemma trace_unitary_comparison_sub_invariant {D Y : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : (D + Y).IsHermitian) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hY : conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U Y = Y) :
    0 ≤ (trace (hA.cfc f * (2 • D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) D))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_unitary_conjugate
statement:
lemma trace_unitary_conjugate (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A) = trace A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.derivative_continuous
statement:
lemma derivative_continuous (σ : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ (max t 0 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.gammaWeight_integrable
statement:
lemma gammaWeight_integrable {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) :
    IntegrableOn (gammaWeight σ) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.gammaWeight_integral
statement:
lemma gammaWeight_integral {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) :
    (∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), gammaWeight σ v) = 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.gammaWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma gammaWeight_nonneg {σ v : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    0 ≤ gammaWeight σ v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.gamma_mixture
statement:
lemma gamma_mixture {σ h x : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    (∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), gammaWeight σ v * Real.exp (-v * h * x ^ 2)) =
      (1 + h * x ^ 2) ^ (σ - 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.inverse_mu_positive
statement:
lemma inverse_mu_positive {σ δ m : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    0 < (m + δ ^ σ) ^ (1 / σ) - δ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mu_eq_nonneg
statement:
lemma mu_eq_nonneg {σ δ z : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarMu σ δ z = (z + δ) ^ σ - δ ^ σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mu_integrand_integrable
statement:
lemma mu_integrand_integrable {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (z : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun s : ℝ ↦ regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2 + z) -
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mu_inverse
statement:
lemma mu_inverse {σ δ m : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    scalarMu σ δ ((m + δ ^ σ) ^ (1 / σ) - δ) = m

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mu_le_rpow
statement:
lemma mu_le_rpow {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) : scalarMu σ δ d ≤ d ^ σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mu_strictMono
statement:
lemma mu_strictMono {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    StrictMono (scalarMu σ δ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mu_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma mu_zero (σ δ : ℝ) : scalarMu σ δ 0 = 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.normalization_integrable
statement:
lemma normalization_integrable {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) :
    Integrable (fun s : ℝ ↦ (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.normalization_integral_pos
statement:
lemma normalization_integral_pos {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) :
    0 < ∫ s : ℝ, (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.normalization_pos
statement:
lemma normalization_pos {σ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) :
    0 < fieldNormalization σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_concave
statement:
lemma primitive_concave {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ univ (regularizedPrimitive σ δ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_deriv
statement:
lemma primitive_deriv (σ : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (y : ℝ) :
    deriv (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) y = (max y 0 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_difference_bound
statement:
lemma primitive_difference_bound {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (z s : ℝ) :
    ‖regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2 + z) - regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2)‖ ≤
      (max (s ^ 2 - |z|) 0 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * |z|

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_differentiable
statement:
lemma primitive_differentiable (σ : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (regularizedPrimitive σ δ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_nonneg
statement:
lemma primitive_nonneg (σ : ℝ) {δ y : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    0 ≤ regularizedPrimitive σ δ y

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_resolvent_representation
statement:
lemma primitive_resolvent_representation {σ δ y : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    regularizedPrimitive σ δ y = resolventNormalization (σ - 1 / 2) *
      ∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), resolventDifference (σ - 1 / 2) δ y v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_strictMono
statement:
lemma primitive_strictMono (σ : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    StrictMono (regularizedPrimitive σ δ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma primitive_zero (σ δ : ℝ) : regularizedPrimitive σ δ 0 = 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.quadratic_integral_scale
statement:
lemma quadratic_integral_scale (t : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ s : ℝ, (s ^ 2 + a) ^ t) =
      a ^ (t + 1 / 2) * ∫ s : ℝ, (1 + s ^ 2) ^ t

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.rankone_scalar_power
statement:
lemma rankone_scalar_power {σ δ m d : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hm : 0 < m) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (he : scalarMu σ δ d = m) :
    m ^ (1 + 1 / σ) ≤ d * m

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.resolvent_difference_eq
OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.resolvent_difference_integrable
statement:
lemma resolvent_difference_integrable {β δ y : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hy : -δ / 2 < y) :
    IntegrableOn (resolventDifference β δ y) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.resolvent_kernel_integrable
statement:
lemma resolvent_kernel_integrable {β a : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1)
    (ha : 0 < a) : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ ↦ v ^ β / (a + v) ^ 2) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.resolvent_kernel_integral_pos
statement:
lemma resolvent_kernel_integral_pos {β a : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1)
    (ha : 0 < a) : 0 < ∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), v ^ β / (a + v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.resolvent_kernel_integral_scale
statement:
lemma resolvent_kernel_integral_scale (β : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), v ^ β / (a + v) ^ 2) =
      a ^ (β - 1) * ∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), v ^ β / (1 + v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.resolvent_normalization_pos
statement:
lemma resolvent_normalization_pos {β : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1) :
    0 < resolventNormalization β

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.shifted_base_lower
statement:
lemma shifted_base_lower {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (z s : ℝ) :
    (δ / (δ + |z| + 1)) * (1 + s ^ 2) ≤ max (s ^ 2 + z) 0 + δ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.shifted_derivative_integrable
statement:
lemma shifted_derivative_integrable {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (z : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun s : ℝ ↦ (max (s ^ 2 + z) 0 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.compact_penalty
statement:
lemma compact_penalty {X : Type u5} [TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X}
    (hK : IsCompact K) {f g : X → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g)
    (hg₀ : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ g x) (hzero : ∀ x ∈ K, g x = 0 → f x ≤ 0)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ t₀ →
      ∀ x ∈ K, f x - g x / t ≤ η

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_diagonal_real
statement:
lemma cfc_diagonal_real (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    cfc f (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))) = diagonal (fun i ↦ (f (x i) : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_resolventDifference
statement:
lemma cfc_resolventDifference {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (β : ℝ) {δ v : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    hA.isHermitian.cfc (fun y ↦ resolventDifference β δ y v) =
      resolventMatrix β δ A v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_shifted_inverse
statement:
lemma cfc_shifted_inverse {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    hA.isHermitian.cfc (fun y ↦ (y + a)⁻¹) = (A + a • 1)⁻¹

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuousOn_shifted_inverse
statement:
lemma continuousOn_shifted_inverse {Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hY : Y.PosSemidef)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ ↦ (Y + (δ + v) • 1)⁻¹) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.diagonal_real_posSemidef
statement:
lemma diagonal_real_posSemidef (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))).PosSemidef

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_hermitian_cfc
statement:
lemma integrable_hermitian_cfc {X : Type u7} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : X → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x ↦ f x (hA.eigenvalues i)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ hA.cfc (f x)) μ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_resolventMatrix
statement:
lemma integrable_resolventMatrix {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {β δ : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    IntegrableOn (resolventMatrix β δ A) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_resolventTangentKernel
statement:
lemma integrable_resolventTangentKernel {Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hY : Y.PosSemidef)
    (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) {β δ : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    IntegrableOn (resolventTangentKernel β δ Y Z) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integral_hermitian_cfc
statement:
lemma integral_hermitian_cfc {X : Type u8} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : X → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x ↦ f x (hA.eigenvalues i)) μ) :
    ∫ x, hA.cfc (f x) ∂μ = hA.cfc (fun t ↦ ∫ x, f x t ∂μ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integral_resolventTangent_diagonal
statement:
lemma integral_resolventTangent_diagonal {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    resolventNormalization (σ - 1 / 2) •
      ∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), resolventTangentKernel (σ - 1 / 2) δ
        (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))) Z v =
      fun i j ↦ (dividedPrimitive σ δ (x i) (x j) : ℂ) * Z i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.inverse_diagonal_real
statement:
lemma inverse_diagonal_real (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ≠ 0) :
    (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ)))⁻¹ = diagonal (fun i ↦ ((x i)⁻¹ : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.primitive_cfc_resolvent_representation
statement:
lemma primitive_cfc_resolvent_representation {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    hA.isHermitian.cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) =
      resolventNormalization (σ - 1 / 2) •
        ∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), resolventMatrix (σ - 1 / 2) δ A v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.primitive_cfc_tangent
statement:
lemma primitive_cfc_tangent {X Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) (hY : Y.PosSemidef)
    {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    hX.isHermitian.cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) ≤
      hY.isHermitian.cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) +
        resolventNormalization (σ - 1 / 2) •
          ∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), resolventTangentKernel (σ - 1 / 2) δ Y (X - Y) v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.resolventMatrix_le
statement:
lemma resolventMatrix_le {X Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) (hY : Y.PosSemidef)
    {β δ v : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hv : 0 < v) :
    resolventMatrix β δ X v ≤ resolventMatrix β δ Y v + resolventTangentKernel β δ Y (X - Y) v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.resolventTangentKernel_diagonal
statement:
lemma resolventTangentKernel_diagonal {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (β : ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (i j : n) :
    resolventTangentKernel β δ (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))) Z v i j =
      ((v ^ β / ((x i + δ + v) * (x j + δ + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Z i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.shifted_diagonal_real
statement:
lemma shifted_diagonal_real (x : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ)) + a • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      diagonal (fun i ↦ ((x i + a : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.shifted_inverse_norm_le
statement:
lemma shifted_inverse_norm_le {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ‖(A + a • 1)⁻¹‖ ≤ a⁻¹

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.shifted_posDef
statement:
lemma shifted_posDef {Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hY : Y.PosSemidef) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (Y + a • 1).PosDef

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.spectralCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma spectralCLM_apply {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    spectralCLM hA x = conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) hA.eigenvectorUnitary
      (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ)))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.continuousOn_divided_integrand
statement:
lemma continuousOn_divided_integrand (σ : ℝ) {δ x y : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    ContinuousOn (fun τ : ℝ ↦ (τ * x + (1 - τ) * y + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)) (Icc 0 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.convex_combo_nonneg
statement:
lemma convex_combo_nonneg {x y τ : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hτ : τ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ τ * x + (1 - τ) * y

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.dividedPrimitive_mul_sub
statement:
lemma dividedPrimitive_mul_sub (σ : ℝ) {δ x y : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    (x - y) * dividedPrimitive σ δ x y =
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ x - regularizedPrimitive σ δ y

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.dividedPrimitive_self
statement:
lemma dividedPrimitive_self (σ δ x : ℝ) :
    dividedPrimitive σ δ x x = (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.integrable_divided_quadratic
statement:
lemma integrable_divided_quadratic {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (x y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun s ↦ dividedPrimitive σ δ ((s - x) ^ 2 + d) ((s - y) ^ 2 + d))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.integral_divided_quadratic
statement:
lemma integral_divided_quadratic {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (x y : ℝ) :
    fieldNormalization σ *
      (∫ s : ℝ, dividedPrimitive σ δ ((s - x) ^ 2 + d) ((s - y) ^ 2 + d)) =
      σ * (d + δ) ^ (σ - 1) *
        ∫ τ in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (1 + τ * (1 - τ) / (d + δ) * (x - y) ^ 2) ^ (σ - 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.integral_quadraticDivided_left
statement:
lemma integral_quadraticDivided_left {σ δ d τ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hτ : τ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : ℝ) :
    (∫ s : ℝ, quadraticDividedIntegrand σ δ d x y s τ) =
      (d + δ + τ * (1 - τ) * (x - y) ^ 2) ^ (σ - 1) *
        ∫ s : ℝ, (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mixed_resolvent_eq_divided
statement:
lemma mixed_resolvent_eq_divided {σ δ x y : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    resolventNormalization (σ - 1 / 2) *
      (∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), v ^ (σ - 1 / 2) / ((x + δ + v) * (y + δ + v))) =
        dividedPrimitive σ δ x y

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.mixed_resolvent_integrable
statement:
lemma mixed_resolvent_integrable {β δ x y : ℝ} (hβ₀ : -1 < β) (hβ₁ : β < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ ↦ v ^ β / ((x + δ + v) * (y + δ + v))) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.quadraticDivided_integrable_left
statement:
lemma quadraticDivided_integrable_left {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (d x y τ : ℝ) : Integrable (fun s ↦ quadraticDividedIntegrand σ δ d x y s τ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.quadraticDivided_integrable_prod
statement:
lemma quadraticDivided_integrable_prod {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (x y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ quadraticDividedIntegrand σ δ d x y p.1 p.2)
      (volume.prod (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.quadratic_combo
statement:
lemma quadratic_combo (d x y s τ : ℝ) :
    τ * ((s - x) ^ 2 + d) + (1 - τ) * ((s - y) ^ 2 + d) =
      (s - (τ * x + (1 - τ) * y)) ^ 2 + (d + τ * (1 - τ) * (x - y) ^ 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuousOn_powerSchur_tau
statement:
lemma continuousOn_powerSchur_tau (σ : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun τ ↦ powerSchur σ z (τ * (1 - τ) / a) D) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuous_gaussianSchur
statement:
lemma continuous_gaussianSchur (z : n → ℝ) (h : ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Continuous (fun v ↦ gaussianSchur z v h D)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.gamma_gaussianSchur_integral
statement:
lemma gamma_gaussianSchur_integral {σ h : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∫ v in Ioi (0 : ℝ), gammaWeight σ v • gaussianSchur z v h D) =
      powerSchur σ z h D

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.gamma_integrable_gaussianSchur
statement:
lemma gamma_integrable_gaussianSchur {σ h : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun v ↦ gammaWeight σ v • gaussianSchur z v h D) (Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.gaussianSchur_eq_average
statement:
lemma gaussianSchur_eq_average (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) {v h : ℝ}
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    gaussianSchur z v h D = ∫ t,
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) D
        ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 ⟨2 * v * h, by positivity⟩

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.gaussianSchur_norm_le
statement:
lemma gaussianSchur_norm_le (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) {v h : ℝ}
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hh : 0 ≤ h) : ‖gaussianSchur z v h D‖ ≤ ‖D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_powerSchur_tau
statement:
lemma integrable_powerSchur_tau (σ : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun τ ↦ powerSchur σ z (τ * (1 - τ) / a) D) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_quadraticTangent
statement:
lemma integrable_quadraticTangent {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (z : n → ℝ) (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Integrable (quadraticTangent σ δ d z Z)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integral_quadraticTangent
statement:
lemma integral_quadraticTangent {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (z : n → ℝ) (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    fieldNormalization σ • ∫ s : ℝ, quadraticTangent σ δ d z Z s =
      (σ * (d + δ) ^ (σ - 1)) • tangentSchur σ (d + δ) z Z

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.powerSchur_trace_comparison
statement:
lemma powerSchur_trace_comparison {σ h : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (z : n → ℝ) (M D : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpoint : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (trace (M * (2 • D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (phaseUnitary z t)) D))).re) :
    (trace (M * powerSchur σ z h D)).re ≤ (trace (M * D)).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.primitive_diagonal_tangent
statement:
lemma primitive_diagonal_tangent {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (z : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) {X : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    hX.isHermitian.cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) ≤
      cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (diagonal (fun i ↦ (((s - z i) ^ 2 + d : ℝ) : ℂ))) +
      quadraticTangent σ δ d z (X - diagonal (fun i ↦ (((s - z i) ^ 2 + d : ℝ) : ℂ))) s

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.primitive_state_jensen
statement:
lemma primitive_state_jensen {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A)
    (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1) {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    φ (cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) A) ≤ regularizedPrimitive σ δ (φ A)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.tangentSchur_apply
statement:
lemma tangentSchur_apply (σ : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (z : n → ℝ) (Z : Matrix n n ℂ) (i j : n) :
    tangentSchur σ a z Z i j =
      ((∫ τ in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 + τ * (1 - τ) / a * (z i - z j) ^ 2) ^
        (σ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Z i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.tangentSchur_one
statement:
lemma tangentSchur_one (σ a : ℝ) (z : n → ℝ) :
    tangentSchur σ a z 1 = 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.tangentSchur_selfAdjoint
statement:
lemma tangentSchur_selfAdjoint (σ : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : n → ℝ) (D M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace (M * tangentSchur σ a z D) = trace (tangentSchur σ a z M * D)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.tangentSchur_trace_comparison
statement:
lemma tangentSchur_trace_comparison {σ a : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : n → ℝ) (M D : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpoint : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (trace (M * (2 • D -
      Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) D -
      Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (phaseUnitary z t)) D))).re) :
    (trace (M * tangentSchur σ a z D)).re ≤ (trace (M * D)).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_le_tangent
statement:
lemma primitive_le_tangent {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (x y : ℝ) :
    regularizedPrimitive σ δ y ≤ regularizedPrimitive σ δ x +
      (max x 0 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * (y - x)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_scalar_add
statement:
lemma cfc_scalar_add (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (x : ℝ)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    cfc f (x • 1 + A) = cfc (fun y : ℝ ↦ f (x + y)) A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuous_fieldIntegrand
statement:
lemma continuous_fieldIntegrand {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (σ : ℝ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Continuous (fieldIntegrand σ δ C B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuous_pairedFieldIntegrand
statement:
lemma continuous_pairedFieldIntegrand {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (σ : ℝ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Continuous (pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuous_quadratic_cfc
statement:
lemma continuous_quadratic_cfc {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (σ : ℝ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Continuous (fun s : ℝ ↦ cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (quadraticMatrix C B s))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cutoff_paired_identity
statement:
lemma cutoff_paired_identity {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (σ : ℝ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (R : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in -R..R, pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s) =
      (2 : ℝ) • ∫ s in -R..R, fieldIntegrand σ δ C B s

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_cutoff_limit
statement:
lemma hermitianField_cutoff_limit {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ ↦ fieldNormalization σ • ∫ s in -R..R, fieldIntegrand σ δ C B s)
      atTop (𝓝 (hermitianField σ δ C B))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_pairedFieldIntegrand
statement:
lemma integrable_pairedFieldIntegrand {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    Integrable (pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_bound
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_bound {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : max 1 (2 * (‖C‖ + 2 * ‖B‖)) ≤ s) :
    ‖pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s‖ ≤
      (2 * (3 / 2 - σ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * (‖C‖ + 2 * ‖B‖) ^ 2 +
        2 * ‖C‖ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)) * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_even
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_even (σ δ : ℝ) (C B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Function.Even (pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.perturbed_norm_le
statement:
lemma perturbed_norm_le {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ |s|) :
    ‖C - (2 * s) • B‖ ≤ (‖C‖ + 2 * ‖B‖) * |s|

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.primitive_cfc_taylor_bound
statement:
lemma primitive_cfc_taylor_bound {σ δ a x r : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hxr : a ≤ x - r)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAr : ‖A‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (x • 1 + A) -
        regularizedPrimitive σ δ x • 1 - (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) • A‖ ≤
      (3 / 2 - σ) * (a + δ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * r ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadraticMatrix_hermitian
OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadratic_derivative_weight
statement:
lemma quadratic_derivative_weight {σ δ s : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (s ^ 2 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadratic_taylor_weight
statement:
lemma quadratic_taylor_weight {σ δ s A : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (s ^ 2 / 2 + δ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * (A * s) ^ 2 ≤
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * A ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.spectrum_abs_le_matrix_norm
statement:
lemma spectrum_abs_le_matrix_norm {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ spectrum ℝ A) :
    |y| ≤ ‖A‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.derivative_lipschitz_on_positive
statement:
lemma derivative_lipschitz_on_positive {σ δ a : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (ha : 0 < a) {x y : ℝ} (hx : a ≤ x) (hy : a ≤ y) :
    ‖(x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) - (y + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)‖ ≤
      (3 / 2 - σ) * (a + δ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * ‖x - y‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_quadratic_deriv_tendsto
statement:
lemma primitive_quadratic_deriv_tendsto {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (z : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ 2 * s * (max (s ^ 2 + z) 0 + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_shift_limit
statement:
lemma primitive_shift_limit {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (z b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ ↦ fieldNormalization σ * ∫ s in -R..R,
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ ((s - b) ^ 2 + z) - regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2))
      atTop (𝓝 (scalarMu σ δ z))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_symmetric_shift_zero
statement:
lemma primitive_symmetric_shift_zero {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (z b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ ↦ ∫ s in -R..R,
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ ((s - b) ^ 2 + z) - regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2 + z))
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_taylor_bound
statement:
lemma primitive_taylor_bound {σ δ a x r y : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hxr : a ≤ x - r) (hy : |y| ≤ r) :
    ‖regularizedPrimitive σ δ (x + y) - regularizedPrimitive σ δ x -
      (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * y‖ ≤
      (3 / 2 - σ) * (a + δ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * r ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.symmetric_shift_boundary
statement:
lemma symmetric_shift_boundary {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (he : Function.Even g)
    (R b : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in -R..R, g (s - b) - g s) =
      ∫ t in 0..b, g (R + t) - g (R - b + t)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.symmetric_shift_norm_le
statement:
lemma symmetric_shift_norm_le {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x)
    (he : Function.Even g) (R b C T : ℝ) (hR : T + 2 * |b| ≤ R)
    (hbound : ∀ x, T ≤ x → ‖g' x‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖∫ s in -R..R, g (s - b) - g s‖ ≤ C * |b| ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.symmetric_shift_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma symmetric_shift_tendsto_zero {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x)
    (he : Function.Even g) (hlim : Tendsto g' atTop (𝓝 0)) (b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ ↦ ∫ s in -R..R, g (s - b) - g s) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_unitary_conj
statement:
lemma cfc_unitary_conj {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A) = conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (cfc f A)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexifyCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma complexifyCLM_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : complexifyCLM A = complexify A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma complexify_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (i j : n) : complexify A i j = (A i j : ℂ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_cfc
statement:
lemma complexify_cfc {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    complexify (cfc f A) = cfc f (complexify A)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_diagonal
statement:
lemma complexify_diagonal (x : n → ℝ) :
    complexify (diagonal x) = diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_hermitian
statement: lemma complexify_hermitian {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : (complexify A).IsHermitian

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_matrixField
statement:
lemma complexify_matrixField {N : ℕ} {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    complexify (matrixField σ δ k B) =
      hermitianField σ δ (complexify (diagonal (fun i ↦ k i ^ 2))) (complexify B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_matrixX
statement:
lemma complexify_matrixX {N : ℕ} (k : Fin N → ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    complexify (matrixX k B s) = quadraticMatrix (complexify (diagonal (fun i ↦ k i ^ 2)))
      (complexify B) s

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_trace_real
statement: lemma complexify_trace_real (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : (trace (complexify A)).re = trace A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_truncatedField
statement:
lemma complexify_truncatedField {N : ℕ} {σ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian) (R : ℝ) :
    complexify (truncatedField σ δ k B R) = fieldNormalization σ • ∫ s in -R..R,
      fieldIntegrand σ δ (complexify (diagonal (fun i ↦ k i ^ 2))) (complexify B) s

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.complexify_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma complexify_vecMulVec (a : n → ℝ) :
    complexify (vecMulVec a a) = vecMulVec (fun i ↦ (a i : ℂ)) (star (fun i ↦ (a i : ℂ)))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.continuous_diagonalFieldIntegrand
statement:
lemma continuous_diagonalFieldIntegrand {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (σ d : ℝ) (z : n → ℝ) :
    Continuous (diagonalFieldIntegrand σ δ d z)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.diagonalField_cutoff_limit
statement:
lemma diagonalField_cutoff_limit {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (d : ℝ) (z : n → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ ↦ fieldNormalization σ • ∫ s in -R..R, diagonalFieldIntegrand σ δ d z s)
      atTop (𝓝 (scalarMu σ δ d • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.dot_star_self_vectorMass
statement: lemma dot_star_self_vectorMass (a : n → ℂ) : star a ⬝ᵥ a = (vectorMass a : ℂ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldIntegrand_tangent
statement:
lemma fieldIntegrand_tangent {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (C : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hX : (quadraticMatrix C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) s).PosSemidef) :
    fieldIntegrand σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) s ≤
      diagonalFieldIntegrand σ δ d z s +
        quadraticTangent σ δ d z (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) - d • 1) s

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldIntegrand_trace_phase_nonneg
statement:
lemma fieldIntegrand_trace_phase_nonneg {σ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (z : n → ℝ) (s t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (trace (fieldIntegrand σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) s *
      (2 • (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (phaseUnitary z t))
          (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_conj
statement:
lemma hermitianField_conj {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    hermitianField σ δ (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U C)
      (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U B) =
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (hermitianField σ δ C B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_diagonal_tangent
statement:
lemma hermitianField_diagonal_tangent {σ δ d : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) {C : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (z : n → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ s, (quadraticMatrix C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) s).PosSemidef) :
    hermitianField σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) ≤
      scalarMu σ δ d • 1 + (σ * (d + δ) ^ (σ - 1)) •
        tangentSchur σ (d + δ) z (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) - d • 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_nonneg_implies_quadratic
statement:
lemma hermitianField_nonneg_implies_quadratic {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hM : (hermitianField σ δ C B).PosSemidef) (s : ℝ) :
    (quadraticMatrix C B s).PosSemidef

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_state_jensen
statement:
lemma hermitianField_state_jensen {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (φ : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A) (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    φ (hermitianField σ δ C B) ≤ scalarMu σ δ (φ C - (φ B) ^ 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_tangentSchur_contraction
statement:
lemma hermitianField_tangentSchur_contraction {σ δ a : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (ha : 0 < a) {C : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (z : n → ℝ) :
    (trace (hermitianField σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) *
      tangentSchur σ a z (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))))).re ≤
      (trace (hermitianField σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) *
        (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_trace_phase_nonneg
statement:
lemma hermitianField_trace_phase_nonneg {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) {C : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (z : n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (trace (hermitianField σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) *
      (2 • (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (phaseUnitary z t))
          (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.matrixX_hermitian
statement:
lemma matrixX_hermitian {N : ℕ} (k : Fin N → ℝ) {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ}
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) : (matrixX k B s).IsHermitian

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_conj
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_conj (σ δ : ℝ) {C B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (s : ℝ) :
    pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U C)
      (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U B) s =
        unitaryConjCLM U (pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.phaseUnitary_conj_diagonal
statement:
lemma phaseUnitary_conj_diagonal (z x : n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) (diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))) =
      diagonal (fun i ↦ (x i : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadraticMatrix_conj
statement:
lemma quadraticMatrix_conj (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (C B : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    quadraticMatrix (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U C)
      (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U B) s =
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (quadraticMatrix C B s)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadraticMatrix_sub_diagonal
statement:
lemma quadraticMatrix_sub_diagonal (C : Matrix n n ℂ) (z : n → ℝ) (s d : ℝ) :
    quadraticMatrix C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) s -
      diagonal (fun i ↦ (((s - z i) ^ 2 + d : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) - d • 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankOneClaim
statement: theorem rankOneClaim {N : ℕ} : @RankOneClaim N

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_diagonal_comparison
statement:
lemma rankone_diagonal_comparison {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (z : n → ℝ) (a : n → ℂ)
    (hM : hermitianField σ δ C (diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ))) = vecMulVec a (star a)) :
    (vectorMass a) ^ (1 + 1 / σ) ≤
      (trace (vecMulVec a (star a) * (C - diagonal (fun i ↦ ((z i ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_hermitian_comparison
statement:
lemma rankone_hermitian_comparison {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (a : n → ℂ)
    (hM : hermitianField σ δ C B = vecMulVec a (star a)) :
    (vectorMass a) ^ (1 + 1 / σ) ≤ (trace (vecMulVec a (star a) * (C - B ^ 2))).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_square
statement:
lemma rankone_square (a : n → ℂ) :
    vecMulVec a (star a) * vecMulVec a (star a) = vectorMass a • vecMulVec a (star a)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_trace
statement: lemma rankone_trace (a : n → ℂ) : trace (vecMulVec a (star a)) = (vectorMass a : ℂ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_tracePair_monotone
statement: lemma rankone_tracePair_monotone (a : n → ℂ) : Monotone (tracePairCLM (vecMulVec a (star a)))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_tracePair_one
statement: lemma rankone_tracePair_one (a : n → ℂ) : tracePairCLM (vecMulVec a (star a)) 1 = vectorMass a

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_tracePair_positive
statement:
lemma rankone_tracePair_positive (a : n → ℂ) {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ tracePairCLM (vecMulVec a (star a)) A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.rankone_tracePair_self
statement:
lemma rankone_tracePair_self (a : n → ℂ) :
    tracePairCLM (vecMulVec a (star a)) (vecMulVec a (star a)) = (vectorMass a) ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.realPartCLM_complexify
statement: @[simp] lemma realPartCLM_complexify (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : realPartCLM (complexify A) = A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.source_rankone_comparison
statement:
theorem source_rankone_comparison {N : ℕ} {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (k : Fin N → ℝ) {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (a : Fin N → ℝ) (hM : matrixField σ δ k B = vecMulVec a a) :
    (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ (1 + 1 / σ) ≤
      ∑ i, a i * ((diagonal (fun i ↦ k i ^ 2) - B ^ 2) *ᵥ a) i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.state_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
lemma state_quadratic_nonneg {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (φ : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A) (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1)
    {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hM : (hermitianField σ δ C B).PosSemidef) (s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ φ (quadraticMatrix C B s)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.tangentSchur_sub_smul_one
statement:
lemma tangentSchur_sub_smul_one (σ : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (d : ℝ) :
    tangentSchur σ a z (D - d • 1) = tangentSchur σ a z D - d • 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_conjugate_difference_zero
statement:
lemma trace_conjugate_difference_zero (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    trace (2 • D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) D) = 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.unitaryConjCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma unitaryConjCLM_apply (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConjCLM U A = conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.unitaryState_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma unitaryState_apply (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (i : n) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryState U i A = (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U A i i).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.unitaryState_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma unitaryState_one (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (i : n) :
    unitaryState U i 1 = 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.unitaryState_positive
statement:
lemma unitaryState_positive (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (i : n)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ unitaryState U i A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.unitary_conj_rankone
statement:
lemma unitary_conj_rankone (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (a : n → ℂ) :
    conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (vecMulVec a (star a)) =
      vecMulVec ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ a) (star ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ a))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.vectorMass_eq_zero
statement: lemma vectorMass_eq_zero {a : n → ℂ} : vectorMass a = 0 ↔ a = 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.vectorMass_nonneg
statement: lemma vectorMass_nonneg (a : n → ℂ) : 0 ≤ vectorMass a

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.vectorMass_ofReal
statement: lemma vectorMass_ofReal (a : n → ℝ) : vectorMass (fun i ↦ (a i : ℂ)) = ∑ i, a i ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.vectorMass_unitary
statement:
lemma vectorMass_unitary (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (a : n → ℂ) :
    vectorMass ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) *ᵥ a) = vectorMass a

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_lipschitz_norm
statement:
lemma cfc_lipschitz_norm {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∀ y ∈ spectrum ℝ B, |f x - f y| ≤ L * |x - y|) :
    ‖cfc f A - cfc f B‖ ≤
      (‖(unflattenCLM : EuclideanSpace ℂ (n × n) →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ)‖ *
        ‖(flattenCLM : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (n × n))‖) * L * ‖A - B‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_quadratic_lipschitz
statement:
lemma cfc_quadratic_lipschitz {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hD : D.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (quadraticMatrix C B s) -
      cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (quadraticMatrix C D s)‖ ≤
      matrixNormBridge n * δ ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * (2 * |s|) * ‖B - D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_remainder_eq
statement:
lemma cfc_remainder_eq (σ : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (x : ℝ)
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    cfc (fun y : ℝ ↦ regularizedPrimitive σ δ (x + y) -
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ x - (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * y) A =
      cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (x • 1 + A) -
        regularizedPrimitive σ δ x • 1 - (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) • A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.cfc_remainder_lipschitz
statement:
lemma cfc_remainder_lipschitz {σ δ a x r : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hxr : a ≤ x - r)
    {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hnA : ‖A‖ ≤ r) (hnB : ‖B‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖(cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (x • 1 + A) -
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ x • 1 - (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) • A) -
      (cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (x • 1 + B) -
      regularizedPrimitive σ δ x • 1 - (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) • B)‖ ≤
      matrixNormBridge n * ((3 / 2 - σ) * (a + δ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * r) * ‖A - B‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldLipEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
lemma fieldLipEnvelope_nonneg {σ δ M : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (C : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ fieldLipEnvelope σ δ M C s

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.flatten_norm_sq
statement: lemma flatten_norm_sq (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : ‖flattenCLM A‖ ^ 2 = hsSquared A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_lipschitz_bound
statement:
lemma hermitianField_lipschitz_bound {σ δ M : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hBM : ‖B‖ ≤ M) (hDM : ‖D‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖hermitianField σ δ C B - hermitianField σ δ C D‖ ≤
      (|fieldNormalization σ / 2| * ∫ s : ℝ, fieldLipEnvelope σ δ M C s) * ‖B - D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_locallyLipschitz
statement:
lemma hermitianField_locallyLipschitz {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) :
    LocallyLipschitz (fun B : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) ↦ hermitianField σ δ C B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hsSquared_nonneg
statement: lemma hsSquared_nonneg (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : 0 ≤ hsSquared A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.integrable_fieldLipEnvelope
statement:
lemma integrable_fieldLipEnvelope {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (M : ℝ)
    (C : Matrix n n ℂ) : Integrable (fieldLipEnvelope σ δ M C)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.matrixNormBridge_nonneg
statement: lemma matrixNormBridge_nonneg : 0 ≤ matrixNormBridge n

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.mixed_left_cfc_apply
statement:
lemma mixed_left_cfc_apply {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (V : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (i j : n) :
    (star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * cfc f A * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j =
      (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : ℂ) *
        (star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.mixed_right_cfc_apply
statement:
lemma mixed_right_cfc_apply {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (i j : n) :
    (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * cfc g B * (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j =
      (g (hB.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) *
        (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_lipschitz_envelope
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_lipschitz_envelope {σ δ M : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hBM : ‖B‖ ≤ M) (hDM : ‖D‖ ≤ M) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s - pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C D s‖ ≤
      fieldLipEnvelope σ δ M C s * ‖B - D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_lipschitz_global
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_lipschitz_global {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hD : D.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s - pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C D s‖ ≤
      (4 * matrixNormBridge n * δ ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * |s|) * ‖B - D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_lipschitz_tail
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_lipschitz_tail {σ δ M : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hBM : ‖B‖ ≤ M) (hDM : ‖D‖ ≤ M) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : max 1 (2 * (‖C‖ + 2 * M)) ≤ |s|) :
    ‖pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s - pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C D s‖ ≤
      (4 * matrixNormBridge n * (3 / 2 - σ) * (‖C‖ + 2 * M) *
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)) * ‖B - D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_norm_on_ball
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_norm_on_ball {σ δ M : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) {C B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hBM : ‖B‖ ≤ M) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s‖ ≤
      ‖pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C 0 s‖ + fieldLipEnvelope σ δ M C s * M

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.pairedFieldIntegrand_remainder_difference
statement:
lemma pairedFieldIntegrand_remainder_difference (σ δ : ℝ) (C B D : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C B s - pairedFieldIntegrand σ δ C D s =
      (quadraticRemainder σ δ C B s - quadraticRemainder σ δ C D s) +
      (quadraticRemainder σ δ C B (-s) - quadraticRemainder σ δ C D (-s))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadraticMatrix_sub
statement:
lemma quadraticMatrix_sub (C B D : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    quadraticMatrix C B s - quadraticMatrix C D s = (-2 * s) • (B - D)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadraticRemainder_lipschitz_tail
statement:
lemma quadraticRemainder_lipschitz_tail {σ δ M : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {C B D : Matrix n n ℂ} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hBM : ‖B‖ ≤ M) (hDM : ‖D‖ ≤ M) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : max 1 (2 * (‖C‖ + 2 * M)) ≤ |s|) :
    ‖quadraticRemainder σ δ C B s - quadraticRemainder σ δ C D s‖ ≤
      (2 * matrixNormBridge n * (3 / 2 - σ) * (‖C‖ + 2 * M) *
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ (σ - 3 / 2)) * ‖B - D‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.real_star_mul_real
statement:
lemma real_star_mul_real (x y : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    (star ((x : ℂ) * z) * ((y : ℂ) * z)).re = x * y * Complex.normSq z

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_cfc_product
statement:
lemma trace_cfc_product {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (trace (cfc f A * cfc g B)).re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, f (hA.eigenvalues i) * g (hB.eigenvalues j) *
        Complex.normSq ((star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
          (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_primitive_hasFDerivAt
statement:
lemma trace_primitive_hasFDerivAt {F f : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ∀ x, HasDerivAt F (f x) x) (hf : LipschitzWith C f)
    (A : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) ↦ (trace (cfc F (B : Matrix n n ℂ))).re)
      ((tracePairCLM (cfc f (A : Matrix n n ℂ))).comp hermitianInclusion) A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_secondPrimitive_hasFDerivAt
statement:
lemma trace_secondPrimitive_hasFDerivAt {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (A : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) ↦
      (trace (cfc (secondPrimitive σ δ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ))).re)
      ((tracePairCLM (cfc (regularizedPrimitive σ δ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ))).comp hermitianInclusion) A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_taylor_bound
statement:
lemma trace_taylor_bound {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {F f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, ∀ y ∈ spectrum ℝ B,
      |F y - F x - f x * (y - x)| ≤ L * (y - x) ^ 2) :
    |(trace (cfc F B)).re - (trace (cfc F A)).re - (trace (cfc f A * (B - A))).re| ≤
      L * hsSquared (B - A)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.trace_taylor_identity
statement:
lemma trace_taylor_identity {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (F f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (trace (cfc F B)).re - (trace (cfc F A)).re - (trace (cfc f A * (B - A))).re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (F (hB.eigenvalues j) - F (hA.eigenvalues i) -
        f (hA.eigenvalues i) * (hB.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i)) *
        Complex.normSq ((star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) *
          (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.unflatten_flatten
statement: @[simp] lemma unflatten_flatten (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : unflattenCLM (flattenCLM A) = A

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_lipschitz
statement:
lemma primitive_lipschitz {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    LipschitzWith ⟨δ ^ (σ - 3 / 2), Real.rpow_nonneg hδ.le _⟩
      (regularizedPrimitive σ δ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ScalarProof.primitive_remainder_lipschitz
statement:
lemma primitive_remainder_lipschitz {σ δ a x r y z : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hxr : a ≤ x - r) (hy : |y| ≤ r) (hz : |z| ≤ r) :
    ‖(regularizedPrimitive σ δ (x + y) - regularizedPrimitive σ δ x -
        (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * y) -
      (regularizedPrimitive σ δ (x + z) - regularizedPrimitive σ δ x -
        (x + δ) ^ (σ - 3 / 2) * z)‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 - σ) * (a + δ) ^ (σ - 5 / 2) * r) * ‖y - z‖

lemma hermitianPotential_radial {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.compact_penalty_bound
statement:
lemma compact_penalty_bound {E : Type u35} [TopologicalSpace E] {K : Set E}
    (hK : IsCompact K) {f g : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g)
    (hg0 : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ g x) (hzero : ∀ x ∈ K, g x = 0 → f x ≤ 0)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      ∀ x ∈ K, f x - g x / ε ≤ η

statement:
lemma constraintDefect_continuous {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (k : Fin N → ℝ) :

statement:
lemma constraintDefect_eq_zero_iff (σ δ : ℝ) (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    (z : selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) × (Fin N → ℝ)) :
    constraintDefect σ δ k z = 0 ↔ matrixField σ δ k z.1 = vecMulVec z.2 z.2

statement:
lemma constraintDefect_nonneg (σ δ : ℝ) (k : Fin N → ℝ)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.matrix_compact_penalty
statement:
lemma matrix_compact_penalty {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    {K : Set (selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) × (Fin N → ℝ))} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ∀ z ∈ K,
      actionDefect σ k z - constraintDefect σ δ k z / ε ≤ η

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.PathProof.lower_gram_diagonal
statement:
lemma lower_gram_diagonal {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hC : LowerTriangular C)
    {d : Fin N → ℝ} (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) (hgram : C * C.transpose = diagonal d) :
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → C i j = 0) ∧ (∀ i, C i i ^ 2 = d i)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.PathProof.lower_gram_initial_orbit
statement:
lemma lower_gram_initial_orbit {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i) {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hC : LowerTriangular C)
    (hgram : C * C.transpose = diagonal (fun i ↦ 2 * ε * k i)) :
    ∃ s : Fin N → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) ∧
      C = diagonal (fun i ↦ s i * Real.sqrt (2 * ε * k i))

statement:
lemma triangularLinearInverse_right (c : Fin N → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldIntegrand_diagonal
statement:
lemma fieldIntegrand_diagonal {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (σ : ℝ) (c b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    fieldIntegrand σ δ (diagonal (fun i ↦ (c i : ℂ))) (diagonal (fun i ↦ (b i : ℂ))) s =
      diagonal (fun i ↦ ((regularizedPrimitive σ δ ((s - b i) ^ 2 + (c i - b i ^ 2)) -
        regularizedPrimitive σ δ (s ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldPrimitive_diagonal
statement:
lemma fieldPrimitive_diagonal {N : ℕ} {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k b : Fin N → ℝ) :
    fieldPrimitive σ δ k (diagonal b) =
      -(∑ i, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..b i, scalarMu σ δ (k i ^ 2 - s ^ 2))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldPrimitive_endpoint_jump
statement:
lemma fieldPrimitive_endpoint_jump {N : ℕ} {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) :
    fieldPrimitive σ δ k (-diagonal k) - fieldPrimitive σ δ k (diagonal k) =
      ∑ i, ∫ s in -(k i)..k i, scalarMu σ δ (k i ^ 2 - s ^ 2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.fieldPrimitive_endpoint_limit
statement:
lemma fieldPrimitive_endpoint_limit {N : ℕ} {σ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 ≤ k i) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ ↦ fieldPrimitive σ δ k (-diagonal k) - fieldPrimitive σ δ k (diagonal k))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∑ i, ∫ s in -(k i)..k i, (k i ^ 2 - s ^ 2) ^ σ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hermitianField_diagonal
statement:
lemma hermitianField_diagonal {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (c b : n → ℝ) :
    hermitianField σ δ (diagonal (fun i ↦ (c i : ℂ))) (diagonal (fun i ↦ (b i : ℂ))) =
      diagonal (fun i ↦ (scalarMu σ δ (c i - b i ^ 2) : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.matrixField_diagonal
statement:
lemma matrixField_diagonal {N : ℕ} {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k b : Fin N → ℝ) :
    matrixField σ δ k (diagonal b) = diagonal (fun i ↦ scalarMu σ δ (k i ^ 2 - b i ^ 2))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.quadraticMatrix_diagonal
statement:
lemma quadraticMatrix_diagonal (c b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    quadraticMatrix (diagonal (fun i ↦ (c i : ℂ))) (diagonal (fun i ↦ (b i : ℂ))) s =
      diagonal (fun i ↦ (((s - b i) ^ 2 + (c i - b i ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))

@[simp] lemma realHermitianComplexify_smul (t : ℝ)
    (B : selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ)) :

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.scalar_boundary_limit
statement:
lemma scalar_boundary_limit {σ k : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ ↦ ∫ s in -k..k, scalarMu σ δ (k ^ 2 - s ^ 2))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ s in -k..k, (k ^ 2 - s ^ 2) ^ σ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.scalar_boundary_regularized
statement:
lemma scalar_boundary_regularized {σ δ k : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    (∫ s in -k..k, scalarMu σ δ (k ^ 2 - s ^ 2)) =
      ∫ s in -k..k, (k ^ 2 - s ^ 2 + δ) ^ σ - δ ^ σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.action_penalty_pointwise
statement:
lemma action_penalty_pointwise {σ δ ε : ℝ} (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    (B : selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ)) (a v : Fin N → ℝ) :
    2 * (∑ i, v i * ((B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) *ᵥ a) i) -
        constraintDefect σ δ k (B, a) / ε ≤
      (∑ i, v i ^ 2) + (∑ i, k i ^ 2 * a i ^ 2) - (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ (1 + 1 / σ) +
        (actionDefect σ k (B, a) - constraintDefect σ δ k (B, a) / ε)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.action_pointwise_square_bound
statement:
lemma action_pointwise_square_bound {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (a v : Fin N → ℝ) :
    2 * (∑ i, v i * (B *ᵥ a) i) ≤
      (∑ i, v i ^ 2) + ∑ i, a i * (B ^ 2 *ᵥ a) i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.quadratic_square_real
statement:
lemma quadratic_square_real {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (a : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, a i * (B ^ 2 *ᵥ a) i) = ∑ i, (B *ᵥ a) i ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.quadratic_swap
statement:
lemma quadratic_swap {B : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (a b : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, a i * (B *ᵥ b) i) = ∑ i, b i * (B *ᵥ a) i

    (hl : f l ≤ κ) (hr : -κ ≤ f r)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.augmented_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma Flag.augmented_linearIndependent {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) :

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.combination_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.combination_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.base i : ℝ) ≤ (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i ∧
      (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i ≤ F.base i + 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.combination_strict_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.combination_strict_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.base i : ℝ) < (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i ∧
      (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i < F.base i + 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_cross
statement: lemma Flag.cross_cross {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.cross i).cross i = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_ne
statement: lemma Flag.cross_ne {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : F.cross i ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_order
statement: @[simp] lemma Flag.cross_order {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.cross i).order = F.order

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.cross_vertex {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hik : k.val ≤ (F.order.symm i).val) : (F.cross i).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_antitone
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_antitone {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : F.order.symm i ≤ F.order.symm j) :
    F.depth j (∑ k, w k • F.point k) ≤ F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_combination
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_combination {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n)
    {ι : Type u38} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∑ k, w k = 1) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • x k) = ∑ k, w k * F.depth i (x k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_le_half
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_le_half {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k) ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_lt_half
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_lt_half {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_lt_half_of_pos_zero
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_lt_half_of_pos_zero {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (h₀ : 0 < w 0)
    (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_nonneg
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_nonneg {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_point
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_point {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    F.depth i (F.point k) = if (F.order.symm i).val < k.val then 1 / 2 else 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_pos
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_pos {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_pos_of_weight
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_pos_of_weight {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (hk : (F.order.symm i).val < k.val) (hkw : 0 < w k) :
    0 < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_strictAnti
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_strictAnti {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : F.order.symm i < F.order.symm j) :
    F.depth j (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_strictAnti_of_weight
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_strictAnti_of_weight {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : F.order.symm i < F.order.symm j)
    (hpos : 0 < w (F.order.symm i).succ) :
    F.depth j (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.eq_of_facet_combination
statement:
lemma Flag.eq_of_facet_combination {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F G : Flag n)
    (t : Fin n) (ht : (F.order.symm t).val = n - 1)
    (hbt : F.base t = G.base t) (hct : F.corner t = G.corner t)
    (w z : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k)
    (hwp : ∀ k, k ≠ Fin.last n → 0 < w k) (hz : ∀ k, 0 ≤ z k)
    (hsw : ∑ k, w k = 1) (hsz : ∑ k, z k = 1)
    (he : ∑ k, w k • F.point k = ∑ k, z k • G.point k) : F = G

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.eq_of_strict_combination
statement:
lemma Flag.eq_of_strict_combination {n : ℕ} (F G : Flag n)
    (w z : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hz : ∀ k, 0 ≤ z k)
    (hsw : ∑ k, w k = 1) (hsz : ∑ k, z k = 1)
    (he : ∑ k, w k • F.point k = ∑ k, z k • G.point k) : F = G

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_base
statement: @[simp] lemma Flag.flip_base {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.flip i).base = F.base

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_flip
statement: lemma Flag.flip_flip {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.flip i).flip i = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_ne
statement: lemma Flag.flip_ne {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : F.flip i ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_order
statement: @[simp] lemma Flag.flip_order {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.flip i).order = F.order

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.flip_vertex {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hik : (F.order.symm i).val < k.val) : (F.flip i).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.linearIndependent_steps
statement:
lemma Flag.linearIndependent_steps {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun k : Fin n ↦ F.point k.succ - F.point k.castSucc)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_ne
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_ne {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    F.neighbor j ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_neighbor
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_neighbor {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (F.neighbor j).neighbor j = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_vertex {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hjk : k ≠ j) : (F.neighbor j).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.point_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.point_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.base i : ℝ) ≤ F.point k i ∧ F.point k i ≤ F.base i + 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.point_succ_sub
statement:
lemma Flag.point_succ_sub {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin n) :
    F.point k.succ - F.point k.castSucc = Pi.single (F.order k) (F.step k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_cross
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_cross {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.cross i).reflect s = (F.reflect s).cross i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_false
statement: lemma Flag.reflect_false {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) : F.reflect (fun _ ↦ false) = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_flip
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_flip {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.flip i).reflect s = (F.reflect s).flip i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_neighbor
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_neighbor {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : Fin n → Bool)
    (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (F.neighbor j).reflect s = (F.reflect s).neighbor j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_point
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_point {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.reflect s).point k i = if s i then -F.point k i else F.point k i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_reflect
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_reflect {n : ℕ} (s t : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) :
    (F.reflect t).reflect s = F.reflect (fun i ↦ xor (s i) (t i))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_swap
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_swap {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (F.swap i j).reflect s = (F.reflect s).swap i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_vertex {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.reflect s).vertex k i = if s i then -F.vertex k i else F.vertex k i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.step_ne_zero
statement: lemma Flag.step_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : F.step i ≠ 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.swap_ne
statement: lemma Flag.swap_ne {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) : F.swap i j ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.swap_swap
statement:
lemma Flag.swap_swap {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (F.swap i j).swap i j = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.swap_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.swap_vertex {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hik : i.val < k.val ↔ j.val < k.val) : (F.swap i j).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.vertex_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.vertex_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    2 * F.base i ≤ F.vertex k i ∧ F.vertex k i ≤ 2 * F.base i + 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.vertex_orbits_distinct
statement:
lemma Flag.vertex_orbits_distinct {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (s : Signs n)
    (he : ∀ i, F.vertex j i = if s.val i then -F.vertex k i else F.vertex k i) : j = k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.linearIndependent_consecutive_iff
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_consecutive_iff {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons (v 0) (fun i ↦ v i.succ - v i.castSucc)) ↔
    LinearIndependent ℝ v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.span_consecutive
statement:
lemma span_consecutive {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.cons (v 0) (fun i ↦ v i.succ - v i.castSucc))) =
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.center_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma Flag.center_apply {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) :
    F.center i = (F.base i : ℝ) + 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_combination_center
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_combination_center {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) :
    dist (∑ k, w k • F.point k) F.center ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_combination_point
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_combination_point {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (∑ l, w l • F.point l) (F.point k) ≤ 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_point_center
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_point_center {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (F.point k) F.center ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_scaled_point_center
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_scaled_point_center {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) : dist (h • F.point k) (h • F.center) ≤ h / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.finite_base_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.finite_base_bounds {n : ℕ} (L U : ℤ) :
    Set.Finite {F : Flag n | ∀ i, L ≤ F.base i ∧ F.base i ≤ U}

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.finite_near_centers
OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_base_of_ne_last
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_base_of_ne_last {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (hj : j ≠ Fin.last n) : (F.neighbor j).base = F.base

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_center_dist
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_center_dist {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (F.neighbor j).center F.center ≤ 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_outside_time
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_outside_time {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (t : Fin n) (m : ℤ) (hlo : 0 ≤ F.base t) (hhi : F.base t < m)
    (hout : ¬ (0 ≤ (F.neighbor j).base t ∧ (F.neighbor j).base t < m)) :
    j = Fin.last n ∧ (F.order.symm t).val = n - 1 ∧
      ((F.base t = 0 ∧ F.corner t = false) ∨ (F.base t = m - 1 ∧ F.corner t = true))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.point_time_boundary
statement:
lemma Flag.point_time_boundary {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (t : Fin n)
    (ht : (F.order.symm t).val = n - 1) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (hk : k ≠ Fin.last n) :
    F.point k t = (F.base t : ℝ) + if F.corner t then 1 else 0

statement:
lemma exists_mixed_generic
    {Q : Type u91} {W : Type u92} {T₁ : Type u93} {T₂ : Type u94} [Fintype Q] [Fintype W] [Fintype T₁] [Fintype T₂]
    (J₁ : T₁ → Type u191) (J₂ : T₂ → Type u192) [∀ t, Fintype (J₁ t)] [∀ t, Fintype (J₂ t)]
    (P : Q → Prop) (b : Q → V) (e : W → Q) (A : W → V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V)
    (v₁ : ∀ t, J₁ t → W) (v₂ : ∀ t, J₂ t → W)
    (he₁ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (e ∘ v₁ t))
    (he₂ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (e ∘ v₂ t))
    (hf₁ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun i : {i // P (e (v₁ t i))} ↦ A (v₁ t i.val) (b (e (v₁ t i.val)))))
    (hf₂ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun i : {i // P (e (v₂ t i))} ↦ ((1 : ℝ), A (v₂ t i.val) (b (e (v₂ t i.val))))))
    (hc₁ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₁ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V)
    (hc₂ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₂ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V + 1)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : {q // ¬ P q} → V,
      (∀ w, dist (mixedVertexEvaluation P b e A a w) (A w (b (e w))) < ε) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ mixedVertexEvaluation P b e A a (v₁ t i))) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ ((1 : ℝ), mixedVertexEvaluation P b e A a (v₂ t i))))

lemma exists_equivariant_generic [Fintype X]
    {T₁ : Type u98} {T₂ : Type u99} [Fintype T₁] [Fintype T₂]
    (J₁ : T₁ → Type u193) (J₂ : T₂ → Type u194) [∀ t, Fintype (J₁ t)] [∀ t, Fintype (J₂ t)]
    (P : X → Prop) (hP : ∀ g : G, ∀ x, P (g • x) ↔ P x)
    (b : X → V) (hb : ∀ g : G, ∀ x, b (g • x) = ρ g (b x))
    (v₁ : ∀ t, J₁ t → X) (v₂ : ∀ t, J₂ t → X)
    (he₁ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (orbitLabel (G := G) ∘ v₁ t))
    (he₂ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (orbitLabel (G := G) ∘ v₂ t))
    (hf₁ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : {i // P (v₁ t i)} ↦ b (v₁ t i.val)))
    (hf₂ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : {i // P (v₂ t i)} ↦ ((1 : ℝ), b (v₂ t i.val))))
    (hc₁ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₁ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V)
    (hc₂ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₂ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V + 1)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : X → V,
      (∀ g : G, ∀ x, a (g • x) = ρ g (a x)) ∧
      (∀ x, dist (a x) (b x) < ε) ∧
      (∀ x, P x → a x = b x) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ a (v₁ t i))) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ ((1 : ℝ), a (v₂ t i))))

statement:
lemma matching_nonzero_rows {l r ε : ℝ} (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (M : Sym N → Sym N) (L Q : ℝ≥0) (hL : LipschitzWith L M)
    (q : Sym N → ℝ) (hq : ∀ A, |q A| ≤ Q)
    (g : Fin N → ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, LocallyLipschitz (g i))
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (hgk : ∀ i, g i (k i) = 0)
    (hc : ∀ i A, (∀ j, i ≠ j → A.val i j = 0) → (M A).val i i = q A * g i (A.val i i))
    (he : ∀ s : Fin N → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) → ∀ A, M (symConj s A) = symConj s (M A))
    (u : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ) (X : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : ∀ p, X p l = symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ p t, t ∈ Icc l r → HasDerivWithinAt (X p) (flowRhs ε M u p t (X p t)) (Icc l r) t)
    (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hXf : X (C,θ) r = -symDiag k) :
    ∀ i, ∃ j, C i j ≠ 0

    (ho : ∀ i j, (∫ t in l..r, u t i * u t j) = if i=j then 1 else 0)
    (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X (flowRhs ε M u (C,0) t (X t)) (Icc l r) t) :
    (X r + symDiag k).val = 2 • diagonal k - ε⁻¹ • (C*C.transpose)

lemma vanishing_row_stationary {l r ε : ℝ} (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (M : Sym N → Sym N) (L Q : ℝ≥0) (hL : LipschitzWith L M)
    (q : Sym N → ℝ) (hq : ∀ A, |q A| ≤ Q)
    (g : Fin N → ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, LocallyLipschitz (g i))
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (hgk : ∀ i, g i (k i) = 0)
    (hc : ∀ i A, (∀ j, i ≠ j → A.val i j = 0) → (M A).val i i = q A * g i (A.val i i))
    (he : ∀ s : Fin N → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) → ∀ A, M (symConj s A) = symConj s (M A))
    (u : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ) (X : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : ∀ p, X p l = symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ p t, t ∈ Icc l r → HasDerivWithinAt (X p) (flowRhs ε M u p t (X p t)) (Icc l r) t)
    (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin N) (hi : ∀ j, C i j = 0) :

statement:
lemma two_sided_barrier {l r κ : ℝ} {h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt h (h' t) (Icc l r) t)
    (hi : h l ≤ κ) (hf : -κ ≤ h r)
    (hs : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, κ < |h t| → h' t ≤ 0) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, |h t| ≤ κ

    (hi : h l ≤ κ)

    ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, h t ≤ κ

statement:

lemma complexify_conj (U : unitary (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ))

lemma sourceField_state_nonpos {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (A : Sym N)
    (φ : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A) (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixFlow.source_path_state_barrier
statement:
lemma source_path_state_barrier {σ δ ε l r : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (q : Sym N → ℝ) (hq : ∀ A, 0 ≤ q A) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k) (hXf : X r = -symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X
      (ε⁻¹ • (q (X t) • sourceField σ δ hσ₁ hδ k (X t) - symOuter (a t))) (Icc l r) t)
    (φ : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A) (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, |φ (complexify (X t).val)| ≤ ‖k‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.penalized_action_integral
statement:
lemma penalized_action_integral {σ δ ε l r η : ℝ}
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a v : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc l r)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc l r))
    (had : ∀ t ∈ Ioo l r, ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ a t i) (v t i) t)
    (hal : a l = 0) (har : a r = 0) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k) (hXf : X r = -symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X
      (ε⁻¹ • (sourceField σ δ hσ₁ hδ k (X t) - symOuter (a t))) (Icc l r) t)
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, actionDefect σ k (X t,a t) - constraintDefect σ δ k (X t,a t)/ε ≤ η) :
    fieldPrimitive σ δ k (-diagonal k) - fieldPrimitive σ δ k (diagonal k) ≤
      (∫ t in l..r, actionDensity σ k (a t) (v t)) + (r-l)*η

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.betaAction_eq_Gamma
statement:
lemma betaAction_eq_Gamma {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    betaAction σ = Real.sqrt Real.pi * Real.Gamma (σ+1) / Real.Gamma (σ+3/2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.betaAction_eq_beta
statement:
lemma betaAction_eq_beta {σ : ℝ} (_hσ : 0 < σ) :
    betaAction σ = 2 * (4 : ℝ)^σ * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t^σ*(1-t)^σ)

statement: lemma betaAction_pos {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : 0 < betaAction σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.boundary_action_scaling
statement:
lemma boundary_action_scaling {σ k : ℝ} (_hσ : 0 < σ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∫ s in -k..k, (k^2-s^2)^σ) = k^(1+2*σ)*betaAction σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.real_beta_symmetric
statement:
lemma real_beta_symmetric {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t^σ*(1-t)^σ) =
      Real.Gamma (σ+1)^2 / Real.Gamma (2*(σ+1))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.young_over_beta
statement:
lemma young_over_beta {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (σ^σ/(1+σ)^(1+σ))/betaAction σ =
      (σ/(σ+1))^σ*Real.Gamma (σ+3/2)/(Real.sqrt Real.pi*Real.Gamma (σ+2))

lemma primitive_weak_derivative {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : LocallyIntegrable g volume)
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ) :
    (∫ x, (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, g t) * deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, g x * φ x)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.SobolevProof.real_eigen_of_weak
statement:
lemma real_eigen_of_weak {W f g : ℝ → ℝ} {k : ℝ}
    (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (hg : MemLp g 2 volume)
    (hW : LocallyIntegrable W volume)
    (hw : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x, f x*deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, g x*φ x))
    (hwe : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x, g x*deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, (k^2-W x)*f x*φ x)) :
    ∃ u : RealEigenfunction W k, f =ᵐ[volume] u.val ∧ g =ᵐ[volume] u.grad

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.SobolevProof.weak_derivative_representation
statement:
lemma weak_derivative_representation {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f volume) (hg : LocallyIntegrable g volume)
    (hw : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x, f x * deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, g x * φ x)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, f =ᵐ[volume] fun x ↦ c + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, g t

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.SpectralProof.triangular_action_upper
statement:
lemma triangular_action_upper {σ l r : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a v : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc l r)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc l r))
    {W : ℝ → ℝ} (hW : IntervalIntegrable W volume l r)
    (hWn : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ W x)
    (hWp : Integrable (fun x ↦ W x^(1+σ)))
    (he : (∫ t in l..r, (∑ i, v t i^2)+(∑ i, k i^2*a t i^2)) ≤
      ∫ t in l..r, W t*(∑ i, a t i^2)) :
    (∫ t in l..r, actionDensity σ k (a t) (v t)) ≤
      actionYoungConstant σ * ∫ t, W t^(1+σ)
